About the Role:

I am looking for a reliable, creative, and detail-oriented Short-Form Video Editor from the Philippines to help edit engaging videos for my brand.

Edit 3 short-form videos per week (50 to 80 seconds each).

Synchronize split-screen visuals (Top: Omegle clip / Bottom: Music video or performance clip).

Add dynamic captions/subtitles, sound effects (SFX), clean transitions, and visual hooks to maintain high audience retention.

Ensure audio levels are properly balanced (dialogue vs. background music).

Follow a consistent template and brand style while maintaining fast turnaround times.

Proven experience editing short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

High proficiency in Premiere Pro, CapCut (Desktop), or DaVinci Resolve.

Strong sense of pacing, timing, and audio sync (especially with musical elements).

Great eye for captions/subtitles, typography, and motion graphic overlays.

Stable high-speed internet connection and a reliable work setup.

Good communication skills and ability to meet weekly deadlines consistently.

Compensation & Work Hours:

Starting Rate: $350 USD / month (Part-time output: 3 short-form videos/week).

Payment Frequency: Bi-weekly or monthly (via Wise or PayPal).

Growth: Opportunities for pay increases, long-form content work, and full-time hours as the channel grows.

Please include:

Portfolio / Video Links: 3–5 examples of short-form videos you have edited (especially split-screen, music-focused, or dialogue/caption-heavy content).

Turnaround Time: How long does it usually take you to finish one 60-second edited short?

title: YouTube Tutorial Video Editor — Fixed-Price Project, 25 Videos (Spreadsheet Template Business)
description:
Hi, I'm Toni! I run TopSheets, a growing digital product business selling spreadsheet templates (Google Sheets + Excel) on Etsy and my own website. I need a video editor to polish a backlog of around 25 tutorial videos into YouTube-ready content.



This is a fixed-price project, not an ongoing weekly role — I have 25 videos that need the same treatment, and once they're done, the project is complete. Work on your own schedule; there's no weekly task list and no fixed hours. You'll be paid per video as you deliver them.



Every video follows the same format, so once you've done one or two, the rest go quickly — this is repetitive, template-driven work, which is exactly why it's priced and delivered per video rather than by the hour.



What You'll Do



- Polish-edit screen-recording tutorial videos (8–20 min finished). I provide a rough cut with the audio, screen recording, and my talking-head footage already synced and mistakes already removed — your job is to make it YouTube-ready

- Add zoom-ins and highlight callouts on the cells/formulas being discussed as I talk through them

- Light text overlays and pacing polish, matching my existing style (examples provided)

- Clean, simple editing style — NO flashy transitions, NO fast-cut effects. Think calm, clear, helpful — this is educational content, not entertainment

- I handle thumbnails, descriptions, and publishing myself — your job ends at the finished long-form export



Requirements



- Proven video editing experience (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar) — portfolio required

- Comfortable following a consistent style guide closely and repeating a process accurately across many videos

- Strong written English (for reading my notes and any on-screen text)

- Reliable internet and a computer that can edit 1080p video smoothly

- Organized: consistent file naming, uses Google Drive, communicates proactively if something is unclear or delayed

- Bonus (not required): experience editing explainer, tutorial, or software-demo videos



Pay & Process



- **Paid test video:** I'll hire a small number of candidates to each edit one video at a fixed price of $15. This lets me see your work firsthand before committing the full batch. The candidate whose edit best fits my style gets the remaining videos in the project.

- **Full project:** $18 per video, paid as each video is delivered and approved, for the remaining ~24 videos.

- **Delivery:** send me each video as soon as it's done rather than batching them up — I'll review and approve (or request changes) before you move on to the next one.

- **Revisions are part of the job.** If I send back edit notes on a video, I expect those changes made and the revised video delivered before it's considered complete and paid. This is normal and expected — most videos will need at least one small revision round, especially early in the project while you're learning my style.

- This is a one-time project. If it goes well, there's a good chance of similar batches in the future as I release new templates, but I want to be upfront that it isn't an ongoing weekly commitment.



How to Apply



1. Start your application with the word **STORYBOARD** so I know you read this posting.

2. Link 3–5 examples of videos you've edited. At least one should be a tutorial, screen-recording, or explainer-style video if you have one. Tell me in one line what YOU did on each (edited only? added graphics? full production?).

title: B2B Cold Caller / Commission Sales Rep - AI Receptionist for Auto Repair Shops
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read the full post before applying.



Start your application with the word AUTO10 so I know you read the full details.



We are looking for B2B cold callers / sales reps to help promote Twilight Agents, an AI receptionist service for auto repair shops in the United States.



Twilight helps auto repair shops capture missed calls, after-hours callers, customer details, and repair opportunities. The shop owner can test a live demo phone number and sign up online.



Your role:

- Find auto repair shops in the United States

- Call shop owners or managers

- Introduce Twilight Agents

- Get the owner to test the live demo line

- Send the follow-up/signup link

- Encourage the shop to use your unique promo code

- Track your leads and follow-ups

- Keep your own simple list of shops contacted



This is a commission-only role. There is no hourly pay and no base salary.



You earn $25 USD for each qualifying paid customer signup using your unique promo/referral code. Commissions are paid once per week through OnlineJobs.ph / the agreed payment method.



Your promo code gives the customer 10% off the $75 setup fee. That means the shop pays $67.50 upfront instead of $75. Their first 30 days of service are included. After that, their selected monthly plan starts at $297/month.



Example:

10 qualifying customer signups in one week = $250 USD commission for that week.



You will receive:

- Your own promo/referral code

- A sales rep dashboard

- Product information

- Call script

- Objection handling

- Follow-up message templates

- Live demo instructions

Good fit if you:

- Have experience with cold calling, appointment setting, outbound sales, or lead generation

- Speak clear English

- Are comfortable calling U.S. businesses

- Can find leads using Google Maps, Yelp,
, business directories, or other sources

- Can follow up consistently

- Can work independently without needing constant supervision



Not a good fit if:

We are looking to activate a small group of reps quickly.

This role requires someone who can work independently  you'll own your shift, make sound judgment calls, and keep things moving without being managed hour to hour. The right person is organized, responsive, professional with guests, and comfortable juggling multiple tasks across booking platforms and internal systems.



You'll be central to guest communication, cleaner and maintenance coordination, booking-related tasks, and delivering a great guest experience.



Key Responsibilities



-Monitor and respond to guest messages across Airbnb, direct bookings, SMS, and other platforms

-Maintain a friendly, professional, and helpful tone with guests

-Reply to guest inquiries

-Coordinate daily cleaning schedules with cleaners through Slack

-Communicate early check-ins, late check-outs, same-day turns, and special requests

-Manage early check-in and late check-out requests based on availability

-Request related fees through the Airbnb Resolution Center

-Verify security deposits and signed rental agreements before check-in instructions are sent

-Leave guest reviews when appropriate and send post-stay follow-up messages

-Send an end-of-day report covering daily activity, concerns, maintenance, pending follow-ups, and operational updates



Requirements



-Ability to work independently with minimal supervision — self-directed, accountable, and able to prioritize without daily hand-holding

-Professional references required and must be provided before work begins. Candidates who cannot supply verifiable references will not be considered.

-Previous experience in short-term rental, Airbnb, hospitality, property management, or customer service preferred

-Excellent written English and strong communication skills

-Highly responsive and able to manage time-sensitive guest communication

-Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow SOPs exactly

-Comfortable using or learning Airbnb, OwnerRez, Slack, WhatsApp, Quo, and Schlage

-Able to manage multiple conversations and tasks at once

-Professional judgment and a willingness to ask questions before confirming uncertain information



Ideal Candidate



-Organized and dependable

-Calm under pressure

-Friendly and professional with guests

-Proactive with follow-up and communication

-Works independently while staying aligned with the team



Work Expectations



-Available to check messages consistently during shift hours, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST

-Responds quickly to urgent guest matters

-Stays active in Slack and WhatsApp for team updates

-Follows company policies regarding deposits, discounts, reviews, and guest communication

-References must be submitted and cleared prior to the first shift

title: Creative VA — Canva Design, Pinterest & Social Content (Digital Template Business)
description:
Hi, I'm Toni! I run TopSheets, a growing digital product business selling spreadsheet templates (Google Sheets + Excel) on Etsy and my own website in four languages. I need a creative VA to handle the recurring design and content work that keeps the business visible: Pinterest pins, listing graphics, and short-form social content.



This is batch, repetitive, template-driven work — you'll get very fast at it. For example, a typical week might be entirely focused on converting one template to the new listing style: creating those listing pages in 3 different color palette variations, then adapting each of those across our 4 language editions (translations provided to you — no translation work required). That's a dozen-plus finished images from one template, all in the new style and following the same layout. If you like production-style creative work where you get faster and more precise the more you do it, this is a great fit.



This is a part-time role built around a weekly task list — I send you the list at the start of the week, you deliver by the end of the week. You choose your own hours. No time tracking, no fixed schedule. I care about finished work, not hours online.



What You'll Do



**Canva / Listing Design (core, repetitive work):**

- Create/upgrade listing image sets for Etsy and my website: device mockups, feature-highlight slides, "what's included" graphics

- Batch-produce color palette variations of the same listing set (e.g., 3 palettes per template)

- Adapt existing graphics into German, Spanish, and French editions — translated text provided by me, you handle the layout

- Update graphics for bundles and seasonal refreshes using existing templates

- **The main project:** I'm upgrading all my existing listing pages to a new style — I have a style guide to work from, and the job is adapting my current listing images into this new style across the whole catalog. Once you've done a couple, it's the same repeatable process for every template. All future listing mockups (new templates, bundles, seasonal updates) will also follow this new style going forward

- **Reference:** browse my current Etsy shop here: 
 to see the current listings (these are what's being upgraded, so treat them as context, not the target). Whatever the new style looks like, it should stay clean and practical, matching a genuine spreadsheet/planner aesthetic — not flashy, trendy, or AI-generated-looking graphics

- You'll work inside a dedicated Canva workspace folder I'll set up and share with you (edit access) — this gives you everything you need, and lets me request small tweaks to existing mockups down the line



**Pinterest:**

- Design pins in Canva using my brand templates (static + video pins)

- Deliver a set number of finished pins each week — I handle scheduling and descriptions myself



**Social media content (growing part of the role):**

- Create short-form reels/TikToks showing our templates in use — aesthetic, satisfying, planner-community style content

- This becomes a bigger share of the weekly list over time



Requirements



- Strong Canva skills — portfolio required

- Comfortable with batch/repetitive production work and keeping variations organized and on-brand

- Detail-oriented: color consistency, correct text swaps across language versions, no leftover placeholder text

- Strong written English

- Reliable internet

- Organized: consistent file naming, uses Google Drive, communicates proactively if something is unclear or delayed

- Bonus (not required): video editing skills for Reels/Shorts, Pinterest marketing experience, or interest in the planner/stationery content niche



Pay & Process



- **Paid trial week:** I will hire 3 candidates for a one-week paid trial ($45 flat). Everyone gets the same task list and reference assets. One person gets the ongoing role.

- **Ongoing:** flat weekly rate of $65/week for approximately 8–10 hours of tasks, paid weekly via [Wise/PayPal/Payoneer].

- Long-term role, with the social media content piece growing over time as we build that side of the business.



How to Apply



1. Start your application with the word **PALETTE** so I know you read this posting.

2. Link a Canva portfolio or 3–5 examples of design work (listing images, social graphics, mockups). Tell me in one line what YOU did on each.

3. Link 1–2 examples of Pinterest pins you've designed, if you have any. Bonus if you can also name the Pinterest profiles you've managed or created for.

4. Link 1–2 examples of short-form vertical content (Reels/TikToks) you've edited, if you have any — not required, but a plus. Bonus if you can also name accounts you've managed or created content for.

5. In 2–3 sentences, tell me: how do you stay organized when producing lots of variations of the same design (different colors, different languages, etc.)?

6. Link one Instagram or TikTok account (any brand) whose short-form content style you love, and tell me in one sentence why.



Applications that don't follow these steps will not be considered. If anything here needs clarification, feel free to ask before applying. Thanks, and I'm excited to meet you!

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
We sell industrial automation components — VFDs, motors, gearboxes, clutches, and brakes — across four websites: three e-commerce stores and one content. Every customer finding us today found us organically. You will be building the paid program from the ground up.



Why this role exists

Our growth has come entirely from organic search and inbound phone quotes. That works, but it caps how fast we can move and leaves us blind to a large pool of buyers searching for parts we stock and can ship the same week.

We are not looking for someone to inherit a mature account and shave 8% off CPCs. We are looking for someone who can stand up measurement, build clean product feeds from our WooCommerce catalogs, prove out paid search with a controlled test budget, and then scale it.



What you will own

First: measurement. GA4 is installed. That is where our instrumentation ends. There is no conversion tracking on orders, forms, or phone calls. You will build all of it — and because a meaningful share of our revenue closes over the phone after a web-sourced quote request, you will need to think seriously about call tracking and offline conversion import, not just checkout events.



Then: the accounts. Google Ads and Shopping across three storefronts, plus whatever role the two content sites play in the funnel. Campaign structure, feed hygiene, negative keyword discipline, bidding strategy, budget allocation across sites.



Ongoing: the number. Paid search here has to clear a target ROAS of roughly 3:1 to be worth scaling. That is the metric you will be measured against. Online orders are the primary conversion; quote requests and calls are a secondary signal we want tracked and valued honestly, not ignored because they are harder to attribute.



Budget: We are starting with a test budget and scaling it against proven returns rather than committing to a fixed monthly spend up front. If you need a large budget on day one to demonstrate value, this is not the right fit. If you like the idea of a budget that grows because you earned it, read on.

title: Google Ads + Landing Page + GHL Funnel Specialist
description:
We are looking for someone to take ownership of the digital marketing funnel for an established home theatre and home technology business in Sydney, Australia.



This is NOT just a Google Ads media buyer role.



We need someone who can manage the complete journey:



Google Ads → Landing Page → Form/Phone Lead → CRM → Follow-Up → Qualified Lead → Sale



Our main service is complete custom home cinema builds, generally worth around $10,000–$50,000+, so we care much more about qualified leads and actual sales than cheap clicks or cheap leads.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Google Ads



* Manage and optimise Google Search campaigns

* Review search terms regularly

* Add negative keywords

* Improve keyword targeting and match types

* Monitor spend, CPC, CTR, conversions and lead quality

* Test headlines, descriptions and offers

* Know when to make changes and when to leave campaigns alone

* Move budget toward campaigns/keywords producing the best opportunities

* Continuously improve traffic quality rather than simply increasing traffic



Landing Pages / Website



* Build and improve landing pages

* Create landing pages for different services/campaigns when required

* Improve conversion rates

* Update website pages, forms, CTAs and content

* Make sure landing pages clearly match the intent of the Google search/ad

* Test different messaging, layouts and offers



Tracking & Attribution



* Set up Google Ads conversion tracking correctly

* Google Tag Manager

* GA4

* Form tracking

* Phone call tracking

* Ensure conversions are not double counted

* Track campaign/keyword/source information into the CRM where possible

* Troubleshoot tracking issues

* Help us understand exactly which marketing is producing qualified leads and sales



GoHighLevel / CRM



* Build and manage pipelines

* Connect website and landing page forms

* Create lead follow-up automations

* SMS/email automations

* Lead notifications

* Capture lead source and campaign attribution

* Help track leads through Qualified → Quote → Won/Lost



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



Our main KPIs are:



* Qualified Leads

* Cost Per Qualified Lead

* Quotes Generated

* Sales

* Customer Acquisition Cost

* Revenue / ROAS



We still monitor CTR, CPC, conversion rate and CPL, but we do NOT want someone optimising only for cheap clicks or cheap leads.



We want someone who understands the difference between:



Traffic → Lead → Qualified Lead → Sale



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



You should have strong experience with:



* Google Search Ads

* Search term optimisation

* Negative keywords

* Google Tag Manager

* GA4

* Conversion tracking

* Call tracking

* GoHighLevel

* CRM automations

* Landing page creation

* Website/form integrations

* Lead attribution

* Conversion rate optimisation



You need to be proactive.



We do not want someone who checks the account occasionally and sends a generic monthly report.



We want someone who pays attention to the account, regularly reviews what people are actually searching, identifies wasted spend, improves the funnel and communicates what should be changed and why.



TO APPLY



Please answer all of the following:



1. How many years have you managed Google Search Ads?



2. Send examples/screenshots of Google Ads accounts you have managed and explain what you improved.



3. Send examples of landing pages you personally built.



4. Explain your experience with GoHighLevel.



5. Explain how you track:



* Website forms

* Phone calls

* Google Ads leads

* Qualified leads

* Sales



6. A campaign spends $1,000 and generates 10 leads, but none of the leads are qualified. What are the first things you would investigate?



7. Explain the difference between a keyword and a search term in Google Ads.



8. If CTR is strong but very few visitors become leads, what would you investigate?



9. How often do you normally review search terms and make campaign optimisations?



10. What is your hourly/monthly rate and availability?



Please do not send a generic application.



We are specifically looking for someone who understands Google Ads AND the complete funnel after the click.

title: Dispatcher — Fleet Roadside & Mobile Repair Operations
description:
National Fleet Network (NFN) is hiring reliable dispatchers to support our growing roadside and mobile repair network in the United States.



We are looking for 1–2 dispatchers to provide coverage across both daytime and overnight operations.



This role involves coordinating service calls between fleet customers, drivers, technicians, and our internal operations team. You must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where clear communication, urgency, and good judgment are important.



Pay



$4–$6 USD per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.



Long-term opportunity for strong performers as the company grows.



Available Shifts



We are hiring for:



* Day Shift

* Night / Overnight Shift



Exact schedules will be discussed during the interview.



Applicants should clearly state which shift they are applying for and their availability.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Receiving incoming roadside and fleet service requests

* Gathering accurate vehicle, driver, location, and repair information

* Determining the type of technician or service needed

* Contacting and dispatching available technicians

* Monitoring technician acceptance and ETA

* Keeping customers updated throughout the service call

* Following up with technicians while jobs are in progress

* Escalating urgent or unusual situations appropriately

* Updating job information and notes in our dispatch system

* Coordinating parts or repair information when needed

* Making outbound calls to technicians and customers

* Helping ensure jobs are completed and properly documented

* Maintaining professional communication with fleet customers and technicians



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is highly preferred:



* Trucking dispatch

* Roadside assistance

* Mobile mechanic dispatch

* Diesel repair

* Automotive repair

* Heavy-duty truck repair

* Fleet maintenance

* Towing dispatch

* Logistics or transportation operations



Automotive or diesel knowledge is a major advantage.



You do not need to be a mechanic, but you should ideally understand common terms such as:



* No-start

* Battery / alternator issues

* Tire failures

* Air leaks

* Brake problems

* Cooling system issues

* Check-engine or fault codes

* Fuel system problems

* Trailer issues

* Preventive maintenance

* Basic automotive and diesel components



Requirements



We are looking for someone who is:



* Highly reliable and punctual

* Comfortable speaking English on the phone

* Able to communicate clearly with U.S.-based customers and technicians

* Calm under pressure

* Organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable making frequent outbound calls

* Able to manage multiple active service calls at once

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at following procedures

* Able to make reasonable decisions without needing constant supervision

* Comfortable using web-based software and communication tools

* Available consistently for the agreed schedule



You must also have:



* Reliable computer

* Stable high-speed internet

* Quality headset

* Quiet working environment

* Backup internet or mobile data preferred



Important



This is an operations position.



There may be periods when several service calls are active at the same time. We need someone who can stay organized, communicate proactively, and keep jobs moving without waiting to be reminded about every step.



Reliability is extremely important. If you are scheduled to work, we need to know that you will be available and ready to handle calls.

title: Creative Strategist / Editor
description:
We’re looking for someone who sits between creative strategy and editing.



You’ll work mainly with influencer and UGC footage, turning raw content into high-performing paid ads. The editing itself isn’t overly complex - what matters is understanding hooks, pacing, angles, customer psychology, and what actually makes someone stop scrolling and buy.



What you’ll do

Edit influencer / creator footage into direct-response ads

Rework existing footage into stronger hooks, angles and variations

Come up with your own creative ideas instead of just following briefs

Understand the customer deeply and know what messaging and visuals resonate

Review performance data and iterate quickly on winners

Work with voiceovers and new formats when relevant



You will not have an editor under you. You own both the thinking and the execution.



How we work



We move fast.



You won’t wait days for feedback or approvals. We review creative quickly, launch new ads fast, and give you direct feedback based on real performance.



If an idea is good, we test it. If something works, we iterate on it immediately.



Who we want

Strong editing skills

Good understanding of direct-response creative

Performance-minded — you care about what spends and converts, not just what looks good

Fast, reliable and comfortable with direct feedback

Someone who naturally goes the extra mile and improves things without being asked

Fashion / apparel experience is a strong plus

Compensation



$1,500–$2,000/month base + uncapped bonuses tied to winning ads and performance.



If your creative drives results, you’ll be rewarded accordingly.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become exceptionally good at performance creative and grow with the role.

title: Operations Integrator / Manager
description:
Operations Integrator / Operations Manager

Location: Remote

Type: part-time (hours est 15-20 hours per week with room to grow)

Reports to: COO



About the Role

We’re looking for an Operations Integrator to sit between our COO and support team and keep the backend of our fast-paced Australian business running smoothly.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role for someone who can take priorities, solve problems, improve systems and automations, and get things done.



You’ll oversee day-to-day operations, optimise processes, manage technology and automation, and work closely with the COO and support team to keep the business moving. At times, some people management responsibilities of our support team will be required. 



Core Responsibilities

- Own the day-to-day | Work with our support team to deliver across programs, events, products and services

- Process Optimisation | Build, document and improve SOPs and workflows with an automation, human-first mindset

- Technology & Automation | Manage platforms, build automations and funnels, and develop practical tech solutions. You will own our tech stack

- Problem Solving | Identify issues, think critically and implement solutions alongside the COO, without needing step-by-step direction

- Execution | Turn priorities into action quickly, efficiently and with strong attention to detail

- Communication | Communicate clearly and proactively across the CEO, COO, and wider business

- Continuous Improvement | Constantly identify opportunities to make the business more efficient, scalable and effective



What This Role Is

Essentially, you’re an Integrator.

> You’ll have the autonomy to work out how something should be done, rather than simply being given a list of steps to follow.

title: Career, Outreach & Business Operations Assistant
description:
# Virtual Executive Assistant — Career, Outreach & Business Operations



## Position Overview



I am looking for a highly organized, resourceful, AI-savvy Virtual Executive Assistant to help manage my job search, professional networking, follow-ups, calendar, personal priorities, and business-related scheduling.



This is not a basic administrative VA position.



I need someone who can take ownership of ongoing tasks, conduct independent research, use AI effectively, pay close attention to details, identify problems before I notice them, and help make sure my professional and personal commitments stay organized.



A major part of this position will involve managing my job-search process from beginning to end.



## Primary Responsibilities



### 1. Job Research



Find relevant employment opportunities for me every business day using:



- My resume and professional background

- ChatGPT/AI

- 

- LinkedIn

- Indeed

- Company career pages

- Other reputable job platforms



Primary target roles include:



- Sales Development Representative — SDR

- Business Development Representative — BDR

- Account Executive — AE

- Sales Representative

- Business Development

- Partnerships

- Creator/Influencer Partnerships

- E-commerce sales

- Social commerce/TikTok Shop-related sales



Priority industries include:



- Music

- Music technology

- Influencer marketing

- Creator economy

- TikTok/social commerce

- E-commerce

- Artificial intelligence

- SaaS

- Healthcare

- Medical technology

- Food delivery

- Logistics/delivery technology

- B2B services

- B2C services



### Job Qualification Criteria



Prioritize positions that are:



- Entry-level

- No experience required

- Training provided

- Sales trainee programs

- New graduate/early career friendly

- 0–2 years of required sales experience

- Open to transferable experience

- Remote, hybrid, or geographically relevant to me



Do NOT blindly apply to jobs simply to meet an application quota.



Every opportunity should first be checked against my qualifications and career goals.



Target: approximately **10 qualified applications per business day / 50 per week** when enough suitable opportunities are available.



---



## 2. Resume Tailoring



Before submitting applications:



1. Read the complete job description.

2. Compare the position against my master resume.

3. Identify discrepancies, missing information, weak wording, or potential conflicts.

4. Identify the most important skills, responsibilities, keywords, and qualifications from the job posting.

5. Use my established AI resume formula/process to determine appropriate changes.

6. Manually edit the resume using my existing Google Docs resume template.

7. Preserve the formatting and structure of the template.

8. Verify every statement for accuracy.

9. Never invent experience, accomplishments, companies, credentials, dates, or skills.

10. Proofread the finished resume before submitting it.



Each significant opportunity should receive an appropriately tailored resume rather than sending the exact same generic resume everywhere.



---



## 3. Job Applications



Manage the application process from beginning to end.



Responsibilities include:



- Completing applications

- Uploading the correct tailored resume

- Completing standard screening questions

- Maintaining accurate applicant information

- Saving job descriptions when necessary

- Recording application confirmation

- Tracking next steps

- Monitoring deadlines

- Preventing duplicate applications



Approximately 10 qualified applications should be completed per business day.



Applications requiring unusual legal declarations, salary commitments, assessments, recorded video responses, lengthy personality tests, contracts, or information that has not already been authorized should be flagged for me rather than guessed.



---



## 4. Application Tracking



Maintain a master Job Search Tracker.



Each application should include:



- Company

- Position

- Industry

- Location

- Remote/hybrid/on-site

- Salary or compensation range

- Job URL

- Source

- Date discovered

- Date applied

- Resume version used

- Application status

- Recruiter/hiring manager

- Contact information

- Follow-up date

- Interview date

- Interview stage

- Next action

- Notes

- Rejection/offer status



Application stages should be standardized, such as:



**Found → Reviewed → Approved → Resume Tailored → Applied → Follow-Up Due → Recruiter Contact → Interview → Final Interview → Offer / Rejected / Closed**



---



## 5. Follow-Ups



Do not allow submitted applications to simply disappear after submission.



Create and maintain a follow-up system.



Examples:



- Initial recruiter/hiring manager outreach

- Application follow-up

- Interview thank-you

- Interview follow-up

- Networking follow-up

- Mentorship follow-up

- Meeting follow-up



Track when each follow-up should happen and alert me when my involvement is required.



---



## 6. Professional Networking & Mentorship



Regularly research professionals I could learn from or build relationships with.



Priority industries include:



- E-commerce

- TikTok Shop/social commerce

- Influencer marketing

- Creator management

- Music business

- Artist management

- Music marketing

- Sales

- Business development

- AI

- Entrepreneurship

- Partnerships



Potential contacts may include:



- Executives

- Founders

- Directors

- Managers

- Experienced operators

- Sales leaders

- E-commerce professionals

- Creator managers

- Music executives

- Industry consultants



The objective is relationship building and mentorship—not mass spam.



For each strong contact:



1. Research their background.

2. Determine why the person is relevant to my goals.

3. Identify a legitimate point of connection.

4. Draft a personalized outreach message.

5. Track the outreach.

6. Schedule an appropriate follow-up.

7. Record responses and meetings.



Quality is more important than sending hundreds of generic messages.



---



## 7. Calendar & Schedule Management



Help manage my:



- Interviews

- Professional meetings

- Mentorship calls

- Business meetings

- Appointments

- Personal commitments

- Work obligations

- Deadlines

- Follow-ups

- Projects



Before adding or recommending a commitment, check my existing schedule.



The goal is not to fill every available hour.



My schedule should remain realistic and sustainable.



Consider:



- Travel time

- Preparation time

- Work commitments

- Business responsibilities

- Personal obligations

- Meals

- Sleep

- Recovery time

- Transition time between meetings

- Existing priorities



Flag scheduling conflicts before they become a problem.



---



## 8. Daily Executive Summary



At the end of each workday, send me a concise executive summary containing:



### Applications

- Jobs found

- Jobs applied to

- Companies

- Positions

- Important opportunities requiring my attention



### Follow-Ups

- Follow-ups completed

- Follow-ups due tomorrow

- Responses received



### Networking

- Professionals researched

- Outreach sent

- Responses

- Meetings scheduled



### Calendar

- Tomorrow's appointments

- Interviews

- Meetings

- Deadlines



### Action Required From Me

Clearly identify anything that requires my personal involvement.



Example:



**ACTION REQUIRED**

1. Complete assessment for Company A.

2. Review interview invitation from Company B.

3. Approve outreach message to executive at Company C.



---



## 9. Weekly Executive Check-In



At the beginning of each week, ask:



**"What are your goals and plans for this week?"**



Then help translate those goals into an achievable weekly schedule.



Review:



- Career priorities

- Job-search targets

- Interviews

- Networking goals

- Business priorities

- Personal obligations

- Appointments

- Deadlines

- Unfinished tasks from the previous week



The weekly plan should be realistic rather than overloaded.



---



# Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by organization and quality—not simply hours worked.



Key expectations include:



- Approximately 10 qualified job applications per business day

- Approximately 50 qualified applications per week when sufficient opportunities exist

- Applications accurately tracked

- No duplicate applications

- Resume customized when appropriate

- No fabricated resume information

- Important follow-ups completed on time

- Interviews and appointments properly tracked

- Schedule conflicts identified in advance

- Professional networking conducted consistently

- Daily summaries delivered consistently

- Weekly planning completed consistently



---



# Required Skills



The ideal candidate should be strong in:



- Online research

- Google Docs

- Google Sheets

- Google Calendar

- Gmail/email management

- LinkedIn

- Job boards

- ChatGPT/AI tools

- Resume editing

- Written English

- Professional communication

- Scheduling

- Organization

- Attention to detail

- Independent problem solving



You should be comfortable learning new AI tools and workflows.



Experience with recruiting, job-search assistance, executive assistance, sales recruiting, sourcing, LinkedIn outreach, career services, or business development is highly valuable.



---



# What I Do NOT Want



I am not looking for someone who:



- Blindly submits Easy Apply applications

- Uses the same resume for everything

- Mass-spams professionals

- Fabricates information with AI

- Applies to clearly unqualified jobs just to hit a quota

- Requires instructions for every small decision

- Loses track of follow-ups

- Overbooks my calendar

- Says a task is complete without verifying it

- Uses AI output without reviewing it



I want someone who can operate like an executive assistant and project manager.



---



# Ideal Personality



You are:



- Extremely organized

- Proactive

- Detail-oriented

- Reliable

- Curious

- Resourceful

- Comfortable with technology

- Comfortable asking questions when information truly cannot be determined

- Capable of following detailed systems

- Able to notice inconsistencies

- Able to prioritize independently



Most importantly, you should be capable of thinking:



**"What needs to happen next?"**



instead of waiting for me to assign every next step.



---



# Application Instructions



When applying, please include:



1. Your executive/virtual assistant experience.

2. Your experience applying to jobs for clients.

3. Your experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT.

4. Your experience with Google Docs and Sheets.

5. Your experience with LinkedIn research/outreach.

6. An example of a system you have used to manage recurring tasks or follow-ups.

7. Your weekly availability.

8. Your time zone.

9. Your desired hourly or monthly rate.



Please begin your application with the phrase:



**"Career Operations"**



so I know you carefully read the description.

Work From Home Philippines | Work on-site Netherlands

MailWorkers.eu is looking for confident, ambitious women who want something different from the usual. 



Maybe you’ve been waiting for the right opportunity to show what you got and you feel ready to take on a bigger challenge, one that gives you more fulfillment and a real chance to discover yourself and just how far you’re willing to go.

No experience? That’s okay.

• Naturally engaging and comfortable in front of a camera

• Able to hold a conversation and keep it interesting

• Good at making people feel comfortable talking to you

• Socially intelligent and able to read between the lines

• Able to pick up on tone, mood and what someone really means

• Persuasive without sounding pushy or scripted

• Quick-thinking and able to respond naturally when a conversation goes somewhere unexpected

• Curious about people and genuinely interested in getting to know them

• Independent enough to take initiative without needing instructions for every little thing

• Reliable, discreet and able to handle responsibility

• Fluent or highly comfortable communicating in English



Experience in livestreaming, content creation, social media, customer relations, hospitality, sales, online selling or similar people-facing work is an advantage.



But personality, confidence and potential matter more to us than qualifications on paper.



You’ll start with outreach and growth.



You’ll help us find interesting companies and people, create personalized outreach, start conversations and build new relationships.



This is also where we get to know you.



How you communicate. How you think. How you connect with people. How you handle responsibility. And what happens when we give you room to show your personality and take initiative.



What happens if you prove yourself?



Outreach is where you start. It doesn’t have to be where you finish.



As you gain experience, other opportunities may open within the company.



For some, that could mean sales or client relations.



For others, it could mean progressing into a Dedicated Special Assistant or Private Assistant role, working one-to-one with selected European clients.



These roles can be much more personal and varied than a normal VA position.



You could help with communication, research, personal tasks, special projects and one-to-one video calls.



Sometimes a client may simply want an intelligent, interesting person they enjoy talking to, exchanging ideas with and having around.



Every client is different. So is every assignment.



That’s why personality matters.



We’re looking for women who understand people, can read between the lines and are comfortable being themselves.



Bring your personality. Bring your confidence. Show us what makes you different.



Where could it lead?



Strong performers may be offered longer-term opportunities, greater responsibility and higher compensation.



For the right person, there may eventually be an opportunity to relocate to the Netherlands and work with us in Amsterdam.



It isn’t promised.



It’s something you earn.



There may be an opportunity much bigger than you imagined sitting right in front of you. You just have to reach for it.



If you think you have what it takes, send your CV, a few recent pictures and a short personal introduction.



Send it directly to Founder & Owner :  



MailWorkers.eu



Because people trust people.

title: Remote Outbound Caller – US Real Estate (Novation Agents)
description:
About Us

We are launching a new US platform that connects novation-friendly real estate agents with verified real estate investors. Investors post their deals directly on the platform, and agents log in and choose the deals that fit their market and business. No cold chasing, no middlemen, just real deals from verified investors, ready for an agent to list.



We are backed by an active US real estate investment company operating in about 10 states, and we are now building our agent network nationwide.



The Role

You will call US real estate agents who already work with novation deals (or are open to them), have a short professional conversation, ask a few qualifying questions, and introduce them to our platform. Your goal is to get them to sign up and understand how the platform works.



What You Will Do



Working Monday - Friday 9am est - 5pm est (include 1 hour break) 

Make outbound calls to real estate agents across the US from a lead list we provide

Ask qualifying questions, for example:

Have you worked on novation deals before? How many in the last 12 months?

Which areas or counties do you cover?

What price range and property types do you usually work with?

How do you currently get deals from investors?

Explain the platform simply: investors upload deals, agents choose the deals they want, everyone works with verified partners

Book agents for sign-up or a short follow-up call when needed

Log every call, answer, and outcome in our CRM

Report daily numbers (calls, conversations, sign-ups)



Must Have



Experience in US real estate: dispositions, acquisitions, cold calling for investors, or working with US agents

Understanding of how wholesaling and novation deals work (or strong real estate basics and fast learning)

Clear, neutral English with no strong accent. US agents must feel comfortable talking to you

Self-managed and reliable. We don't want to check on you all day. You know what needs to be done and you do it

Stable internet, quiet workspace, good headset

Available to work US business hours



Nice to Have



Experience with CRMs (GoHighLevel, Podio, or similar) and dialers

Experience talking with real estate agents specifically

Experience with a startup or new product launch



How to Apply

Send the following:



Your resume with your US real estate experience clearly listed

A 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your US real estate experience

Your daily availability (in US Eastern Time)

Start your application with the words "Agent Network" so we know you read the full post



Applications without the voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: Wholesale Sourcing VA - Amazon FBA UK/EU Supplier Research
description:
I run a UK-based Amazon FBA wholesale business and I'm looking for a full-time Sourcing VA. One job: find me suppliers nobody else has.



You are not doing outreach and you are not managing the pipeline - I handle all of that. Your entire focus is research: finding and qualifying UK and EU suppliers, then dropping them into my CRM (a Google Sheet I'll give you access to) with everything I need to contact them myself.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- Authorised distributors, wholesalers and brand-direct relationships for brands that already sell on Amazon

- Niche, harder-to-find suppliers - the ones that take real digging

- Suppliers with genuine barriers to entry: high MOQs, trade-only access, application and approval processes, brand authorisation requirements

- Categories: health and beauty, household, grocery, baby, pet, toys, electricals, stationery, sports



WHAT I'M NOT LOOKING FOR

Anything findable in ten minutes on Google. No open-to-all dropship sites, no directories everyone already has, no "wholesale" sites that sell to the public. Low barrier to entry means every other seller is already there, which is no use to me.



WHAT YOU ACTUALLY DO ALL DAY



Find them

- I'll give you my methods and source lists to start with, and I expect you to bring your own on top - if you have a way of finding suppliers that works, use it

- Typical angles: UK and EU trade show exhibitor lists, trade-only directories, brand websites' "stockists" and "where to buy" pages, Companies House, LinkedIn company and people search, EU trade portals

- Reverse-engineer brands already selling on Amazon UK to work out who distributes them here

- Check the CRM first - if it's already in there, move on



Qualify them

- Confirm they are a genuine wholesaler or authorised distributor, not a retailer or dropshipper

- Confirm they trade B2B, and check whether they allow Amazon sellers

- Find the MOQ, the minimum order value and whether there's an application process

- Judge the barrier to entry: is this one everybody already has, or is it hard to get into? Hard to get into is what I want



Get me the contact

title: Content Marketer With Video Editing Skills
description:
## About Us  

We are a fast-growing social media and content marketing agency that helps brands, podcasts, and founders turn attention into leads. Our work spans podcast repurposing, short-form video, social media growth, newsletters, and full-funnel content systems.



This is not a traditional video editor role.



We are looking for someone who understands content first and editing second. Someone who has worked in social media, understands why content performs, and uses editing as a tool to make ideas land harder.



If your strength is fancy transitions or cinematic effects, this role is not a fit. If your strength is knowing what to clip, how to frame it, and why someone would stop scrolling, keep reading.



##The Role



Think of this role as a content marketer who edits.



You will be responsible for shaping raw conversations into short-form content that performs. That means d
 what moments matter, how they should be framed, and how to edit them so the message is clear, engaging, and watchable.



Editing skills are required. Content judgment matters more. 



## What You’ll Do  

- Watch and listen to long-form content to identify moments worth turning into clips.

- D
 what should be edited, not just how it should be edited.

- Turn raw conversations into clear, compelling short-form content people actually want to watch.

- Shape clips using pacing, framing, and structure rather than heavy effects.

- Create strong hooks in the first few seconds using insight, context, or contrast.

- Improve clips by tightening the message, sharpening the point, or reframing the moment.

- Research what works for different audiences and platforms to guide clip selection and structure.

- Work closely with our strategy team to align content with growth and marketing goals.



## What We’re Looking For  

- Proven experience editing for social media (please share examples/portfolio).  

- Ability to identify and create viral hooks.

- Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, and emotional engagement.  

- Knowledge of current social media trends and platform-specific best practices.  

- Research-driven: knows how to study an audience, industry, or trend to inform edits.  

- Proficiency in video editing software (Premiere Pro is preferred).  

- Bonus: experience with motion graphics, memes, or creative overlays.  



## Who You Are  

- Ability to think critically about content and suggest better angles or moments.

- Creative and curious, always testing new styles and approaches.  

- A strong sense of taste. You can recognize a great moment instantly.

- Detail-oriented but fast, balancing quality with turnaround time.  

- Understanding of storytelling, attention, and audience behavior.

- Flexible in editing style, able to adjust for different clients and audiences.  

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro or similar tools.

- Experience editing for social media, with examples that show good judgment, not just clean edits.



##Who You Are

-You care more about whether a clip is worth watching than how polished it looks.

-You naturally think in hooks, moments, and angles.

-You see editing as a form of storytelling and decision-making, not just technical execution.

-You are confident enough to say, “This part won’t work, but this one will.”

-You understand that good content beats perfect edits.



## Why Join Us  

- Work with a team that values creativity and results.  

- Get exposure to a variety of clients and industries.  

- Grow with a company that is scaling quickly in social media and digital marketing.  

- Remote, flexible work with opportunity for long-term growth.  



## How to Apply  

Send examples of short-form content you have worked on and a short explanation of why you chose those moments. We care more about your thinking than your effects. Applications without examples or notes will not be reviewed

150 USD per finished video to start, paid by Wise on delivery. More for editors who prove out over a few episodes. I do not make people chase invoices.

Shortlisted editors get a paid test: 75 USD for a two minute section of real footage, 72 hours to deliver. The same footage goes to everyone shortlisted, and I pay whether or not I hire you.

title: Creative Strategist – Full Time – 8-Figure Ecom Brands
description:
We’re looking for a Creative Strategist who understands WHY people buy.



Not someone who just scrolls the
 Ads Library, copies competitors, and calls it research.



We run multiple 8-figure DTC brands in the US and are building an internal creative team focused on producing high-performing direct-response advertising at scale.



Your job is simple:



Understand the customer → find the right message → turn it into ads that sell.



You’ll work closely with our editors and media buyers to research customers, develop new angles and concepts, analyze performance, and continuously find new ways to communicate our products.



What you'll be doing:



Researching customers, competitors, reviews, Reddit, forums and the wider market

Finding new desires, pain points, objections and emotional triggers

Developing new angles, hooks and creative concepts

Writing scripts and detailed creative briefs

Analyzing winning and losing ads to understand WHY they performed

Turning learnings from winners into new iterations and concepts

Guiding video editors and giving clear creative direction

Working closely with media buyers to understand performance

Developing ideas across UGC, storytelling, advertorial, cinematic and other formats

Helping us build a repeatable system for finding winning creatives

What We're Looking For



You need at least 1 year of experience in creative strategy, direct-response marketing, or a closely related role.



But we value character, work ethic, curiosity and your ability to think more than years of experience.



You should understand:



Eugene Schwartz's 5 Stages of Awareness

Market Sophistication

Customer desires and mass desires

Hooks, angles and mechanisms

Direct-response copywriting

Customer research

Creative testing and iteration



If you don't know Breakthrough Advertising by Eugene Schwartz, please don't apply.



We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to be obsessed with learning and getting better.



We're looking for someone who constantly asks why.



Why did this hook work?



Why did people respond to this angle?



Why did this ad spend $100,000 while another died at $500?



Why does this customer actually want our product?



That's the type of thinking we want on our team.



Compensation



Base salary starts at $2,000/month + 3% of the ad spend generated by your winning creatives.



If you're already highly skilled and can prove it, we're open to discussing a higher base salary.



We want your incentives aligned with ours: the better your creatives perform and the more we can scale them, the more you earn.



You'll also get access to weekly training, mentorship, our internal learnings, and all the tools you need to perform at a high level.



This is a full-time, long-term position working directly with brands doing $1M+ per month.



TO APPLY, SEND US:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience

2. Brands you've worked with

3. 3–5 winning ads/concepts you've personally strategized and their results

4. Your favorite lesson from Breakthrough Advertising and how you've applied it



Please don't send us a generic AI-written application.



We're looking for someone hungry, reliable and genuinely interested in becoming world-class at creative strategy.

title: Screen Recording Tutorial Producer — $1 Per Completed Video | Up to $1,300+/Month
description:
Screen Recording Tutorial Producer — $1 Per Completed Video | Up to $1,300+/Month



💰 Potential to Earn $260–$1,300+ Per Month



I'm looking for reliable people who can produce short screen-recording tutorial videos for my YouTube channels.



You are paid $1 for every completed, upload-ready video.



There can be 10–50 videos available per day, depending on the workload.



That means your potential daily earnings can be:



- 10 videos = $10/day

- 20 videos = $20/day

- 30 videos = $30/day

- 40 videos = $40/day

- 50 videos = $50/day



If you work around 26 days per month, that's approximately $260–$1,300/month, depending on how many completed videos you produce.



There is no fixed requirement to complete 50 videos every day. You d
 how much work you can realistically handle while maintaining quality.



THE JOB



I run YouTube channels that publish short how-to and tutorial videos about software, websites, apps, AI tools, and online platforms.



I'm building a high-volume production system and looking for people who can turn a provided voiceover into a finished tutorial video that is ready to upload immediately.



This is not a script-writing job.



This is not a research job.



You don't need to create thumbnails.



You don't need to record your voice.



I provide the voiceover. You create the finished screen-recording tutorial.



HOW THE WORKS WORK



For each video, I provide only:



1. The video title/topic



2. The finished voiceover audio



Your job is to take those two things and produce the complete video.



The workflow is:



Listen to the voiceover → Open the software → Figure out the current interface → Perform the steps → Record the screen → Synchronize everything → Export → Deliver



That's it.



I intentionally do not provide a long click-by-click recording guide.



The voiceover explains what the viewer needs to do.



You figure out how to perform those actions in the current version of the software.



---



YOU MUST BE ABLE TO NAVIGATE SOFTWARE YOURSELF



This is the most important part of the job.



For example, the voiceover might say:



«"Open Settings, go to Privacy, and turn off this option."»



You should be able to open the application, find Settings, locate Privacy, find the option, and record the process.



If the software has been updated and the button has moved, find the new location yourself.



You do not need to know every application beforehand.



You need to be comfortable exploring software and figuring things out.



I'm looking for someone who can receive a voiceover and think:



"Okay, I understand what needs to happen. Let me find it."



rather than:



"Where exactly do I click?"



---



REFERENCE CHANNEL



There is one permanent reference for the style I want.



Study this channel before applying:



"JustAskJake — YouTube" (
)



You should watch several videos and understand how the tutorials are presented.



I will not send a separate reference video for every assignment.



The channel is the reference.



Once you understand the style, you should be able to reproduce it consistently across different topics.



---



WHAT "COMPLETED VIDEO" MEANS



This is very important.



You are paid for a completed video, not raw screen-recording footage.



When you submit a video, it should be something I can download and upload to YouTube immediately.



I should not have to:



- Re-record anything

- Fix synchronization

- Remove obvious mistakes

- Finish missing steps

- Clean up the screen

- Edit major sections

- Figure out what you were trying to show



You are responsible for delivering the finished tutorial.



If you make a mistake during recording, simply redo that section before submitting.



---



VIDEO REQUIREMENTS



Videos should generally be:



- 1080p

- MP4

- 24–30 FPS

- Clean screen recording

- Properly synchronized with the voiceover

- Easy to follow

- Free of unnecessary pauses

- Free of obvious recording mistakes

- Free of personal information



Do not show:



- Passwords

- Private messages

- Personal documents

- Banking information

- Personal
s

- Notifications

- Other private information



Use demo/test accounts where appropriate.



---



EDITING



These are simple tutorial videos.



You are not expected to create complicated cinematic edits, animations, or motion graphics.



The focus is on making the tutorial clear and professional.



The important things are:



The right screen → the right action → at the right time → with the right result.



---



SOFTWARE YOU MAY WORK WITH



Topics can include:



- Windows 11

- Microsoft Edge

- Google Chrome

- VLC Media Player

- 7-Zip

- OBS Studio

- Adobe Acrobat

- Gmail

- Google Drive

- 

- WhatsApp

- Canva

- Figma

- Notion

- VS Code

- AI tools

- SaaS platforms

- Websites

- Browser extensions

- Desktop applications

- Mobile applications



You do not need to already know all of these.



The ability to learn and navigate unfamiliar software is more important.



---



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



You should be:



- Comfortable using computers

- Good at learning software

- Able to understand spoken English

- Comfortable recording your screen

- Independent

- Detail-oriented

- Fast but accurate

- Reliable

- Able to follow a voiceover precisely

- Comfortable doing repetitive work

- Interested in long-term work



You don't need years of professional video-production experience.



If you can use a computer confidently and learn software quickly, you can do this job.



---



DAILY WORKLOAD



There can be 10–50 videos available per day.



Your actual workload is up to you.



For example:



10 videos → $10



25 videos → $25



50 videos → $50



If you are able to consistently produce a large number of good-quality videos, there can be substantial ongoing work.



Speed matters, but quality comes first.



I would rather receive 20 excellent completed videos than 50 videos that require corrections.



---



PAID TEST



Before receiving regular work, shortlisted applicants will complete one paid test video.



I will provide:



- A title/topic

- The voiceover



You will create the complete upload-ready tutorial.



The test allows me to evaluate:



- Your ability to understand the voiceover

- Your ability to navigate software

- Screen-recording quality

- Timing and synchronization

- Attention to detail

- Ability to reproduce the reference style

- Overall reliability



If the test is good, we can move to regular batches.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions:



1. What computer/device do you use for recording?



2. What operating system do you use?



3. What screen-recording and editing software do you use?



4. How many completed videos can you realistically produce per day?



5. Have you created screen-recording tutorials before?



If yes, send examples.



6. How many hours per day are you available?



7. What would you do if the voiceover describes a button or setting, but the software's current interface has moved it somewhere else?



8. Watch several videos from the reference channel above and briefly explain what you think is important about its recording style.



And one small test to make sure you actually read this post:



Begin your proposal with the word "CompleteVideo".



---



IMPORTANT



This is intended to be long-term, high-volume work.



The workflow is deliberately simple:



I give you the title + voiceover.



You figure out the software + record the tutorial + deliver the finished video.



If you are independent, fast, accurate, and comfortable learning new software, there can be a lot of work available.



$1 per completed video.



10–50 videos can be available per day.



Potential earnings of approximately $260–$1,300+ per month depending on your output and working days.



If you're interested, apply with CompleteVideo at the beginning of your proposal.

VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — QC & DELIVERY SPECIALIST



Company: N & K Real Estate Media Position: Remote Virtual Assistant — QC & Delivery Starting Pay: $5/hour Starting Hours: 20-25 hours per week, with opportunities for additional hours in the future.



 Schedule: Tuesday–Saturday 



Location: Mattoon, IL (Remote)



ABOUT N & K REAL ESTATE MEDIA

N & K Real Estate Media is a professional real estate media company providing professional photography, drone photography and video, virtual tours, video, and other visual media services to real estate agents, property managers, builders, businesses, and other clients.



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who wants to grow with our company.



The starting position will focus primarily on Quality Control (QC) and Delivery, but this position is intended to grow into a larger role as you become familiar with our systems, standards, and workflow.



Our goal is to develop someone who can eventually take on a lead role within the VA side of our company.



STARTING POSITION: QC & DELIVERY

Your primary responsibility will be to make sure completed photo and video projects meet our quality standards before they are delivered to clients.



You will:

* Download completed projects from our editing platforms.

* Review completed photos and videos for quality and consistency.

* Perform quality control before projects are delivered.

* Make corrections when necessary.

* Upload and organize completed projects in our client delivery system.

* Verify that all services ordered by the client have been completed and delivered.

* Add drone pinpoints above homes in aerial images when required.

* Add lot lines or other required markings when necessary.

* Communicate with editors regarding corrections and revisions.

* Communicate through SMS,
, Slack, Instagram, and other platforms as needed.

* Respond promptly and professionally to messages.

* Make sure projects are delivered accurately and on time.



PHOTO QUALITY CONTROL

We use Auto HDR, an AI-powered photo editing system, as part of our editing workflow.



However, AI does not replace the need for an experienced photo editor.



You will be responsible for carefully reviewing the completed Auto HDR images and identifying anything the AI may have missed or incorrectly edited.



This includes checking for:

* Incorrect or inconsistent color

* Exposure problems

* White balance issues

* Unnatural HDR results

* Editing inconsistencies

* Items that should have been removed

* Grass or landscaping issues

* TV screen replacements

* Bracketed photo editing issues

* Other visual problems that do not meet our standards



You may also need to compare the edited image against the original RAW files to determine whether the final image accurately represents the property.



It is extremely important that you have a strong eye for detail and consistency.



Our goal is not simply to deliver images that have been processed by AI. Our goal is to deliver images that meet the N & K Real Estate Media standard.



ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

As you become comfortable with QC and delivery, additional responsibilities may be assigned, including:



Client Communication

* Responding to client
s and text messages.

* Assisting with client communication and follow-up.

* Helping with client acquisition activities.

* Instagram Method



During available time, you may assist with our social media outreach strategy by:

* Liking posts.

* Commenting on posts.

* Engaging with real estate agents.

* Following potential clients.

* Performing other Instagram outreach activities.



Virtual Assistant Tasks

Additional administrative, organizational, research, communication, or operational tasks may be assigned as needed.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You should have:

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong organizational skills.

* Experience with Adobe Photoshop.

* Experience with Adobe Lightroom.

* Experience reviewing and editing photographs.

* The ability to identify subtle color and editing problems.

* The ability to follow detailed instructions and company standards.

* Reliable communication and responsiveness.

* A fast and stable internet connection.

* A reliable computer capable of handling photo editing.

* The ability to work independently.



Previous QC, photo editing, real estate photography, or project delivery experience is strongly preferred.



EQUIPMENT & INTERNET REQUIREMENTS

You must have:

* A reliable computer suitable for photo editing.

* Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom or equivalent professional editing experience.

* Fast and stable internet.

* A backup plan in case of internet or power failure.



We want to know that you can continue communicating with the team and completing your responsibilities if something goes wrong with your primary internet or power.



TEST PROJECT

If you are selected to move forward in the hiring process, we will provide you with a test project.

The test may include tasks such as:

* Editing bracketed real estate photos.

* Grass screening/replacement.

* Object or item removal.

* Color correction and touch-ups.

* TV screen replacements.

* Drone pinpoints on listing addresses.

* Photo quality control.

* Comparing edited images against RAW files.

* Other tasks related to our real estate media workflow.



The purpose of the test is to determine whether your technical skills, attention to detail, and editing judgment meet our standards.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.

You will start primarily with QC and Delivery.

As you gain experience with our systems and demonstrate reliability and accuracy, you can take on additional responsibilities.

More responsibility can lead to:

* More hours.

* Additional duties.

* Increased responsibility within the company.

* Future raises.

* Opportunities to become a lead VA.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with N & K Real Estate Media, rather than someone who is simply looking for a short-term job.



Our goal is to build systems, train people properly, and develop team members who can eventually take ownership of important parts of our operation.



HOW TO APPLY



DO NOT APPLY THROUGH ONLINEJOBS.PH.

Instead, send your application directly to:





IMPORTANT —
 SUBJECT LINE



Your
 subject line MUST contain:

N & K Rocks



Applications that do not follow the subject-line requirement may not be considered.



REQUIRED APPLICATION QUESTIONS

Please answer all three questions in your
:

1. Previous Experience

Do you have any previous job experience in QC and delivery, and are you currently working anywhere else?

Please describe your relevant experience.



2. Availability

What is your current availability, and will you be available to work the requested times?

(We will discuss the specific working hours/time standard during the hiring process.)



3. Equipment & Internet

What is your equipment setup and internet speed? Do you have a backup process if you lose power or internet? If so, what is it?

* A screenshot of your computer specifications.

Bonus points if you answer the three questions above in a short video.

This is completely optional, but it gives us an opportunity to see how you communicate and explain your experience.



PORTFOLIO

 Follows instructions.

Can work independently.

Wants to grow with the company.

title: B2B Outbound Lead Prospecting & Sales Specialist (Setter to Closer Path)
description:
Role: B2B Outbound Lead Prospecting & Sales Specialist (Setter to Closer Path)

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday – Friday, Pacific Standard Time (Flexible: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM PST Part-Time or 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST Full-Time)

Start Date: Immediate





Compensation & Career Progression:

We believe in supporting you while you build your pipeline, offering guaranteed baseline pay during onboarding and a transparent pathway to step into a high-earning, full-cycle closing role as you gain experience.



• Stage 1 — Onboarding Setter Track:

o Competitive Guaranteed Base Pay ($3.00 – $3.50+ USD / hour, negotiable based on outbound B2B experience)

o +$30 – $50 bonus for every qualified appointment that turns into a closed deal

o Guaranteed income while you learn our niche, build lead lists, and master the outreach script.

• Stage 2 — Performance Commission (Setting Track):

o Optional Commission-Only Track

o 10% – 12% of project value ($50 – $200+ per deal, based on website scopes starting at $500+) when you source the lead, book the discovery call, and we close the sale.



• Stage 3 — Full-Cycle Closer Track (Promotion Opportunity):

o Optional Commission-Only Track

o Up to 20% – 25% of total project revenue ($100 – $500+ per closed client).

o Unlocked once you master our offer and take over running website audits, sales presentations, and closing client agreements directly.

o Target monthly earnings: $1,200 – $2,500+ USD (uncapped).

• Payouts: Paid on time, bi-weekly via Wise or Revolut.





Job Overview



We build modern, high-converting websites for small and medium-sized local businesses across the United States. We are looking for an ambitious, ethical, and resourceful B2B Sales Specialist.

You will start by identifying local businesses with strong community reputations (4.0+ stars on Google Maps and Yelp) that currently lack an active or modern website, reaching out to owners, and booking them for complimentary digital audits. As you become proficient with our solutions and objections, you will have the opportunity to run the sales calls yourself and close deals end-to-end.



Key Responsibilities



• Reputation-First Prospecting: Search Google Maps and Yelp for established local businesses (contractors, trades, auto services, specialty clinics, local dining) with strong ratings that have no website, broken links, or outdated pages.

• Need Qualification: Verify that the business is active, healthy, and would genuinely profit from an inbound web presence.

• Decision-Maker Discovery: Track down the actual owner or principal decision-maker using public records, social platforms, and brief verification calls.

• Multi-Touch Outreach: Execute cold calls, personalized follow-up emails, and direct messaging using our conversational, non-pushy outreach frameworks.

• Pipeline Management: Schedule qualified business owners onto the discovery calendar, maintain organized CRM records, and prepare to transition into running product walkthroughs and closing deals.

Candidate Requirements

• B2B Cold Outreach Experience: 1+ years of outbound calling, cold outreach, or appointment setting targeting US or North American business owners.

• Conversational English Fluency: Professional, natural verbal communication with clear tonality on US phone lines.

• Consultative Ethics: We sell real solutions to businesses with clear digital gaps—no high-pressure or misleading tactics.

• Growth Ambition: Eager to develop beyond basic appointment setting into a full-cycle sales professional who presents offers and closes contracts.

• Schedule Alignment: Reliable availability during core US Pacific business hours.

Technical Setup Requirements

• Hardware: Dedicated laptop or PC (minimum Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3, 8 GB RAM).

• Connectivity: Stable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload) plus a mandatory mobile data / hotspot backup.

• Audio/Video: Dedicated noise-canceling USB headset and a functional webcam for internal team check-ins.

• Environment: Quiet, distraction-free home office setup.



How to Apply



To confirm your attention to detail, include this format in your application exactly as:

[Your Full Name] - Web Sales Specialist - 0904





Submit your application with the following:



1. Your updated resume highlighting your outbound sales and appointment-setting experience.

2. A short (60–90 second) Loom video or audio recording covering:

o How you determine whether a business with no website is actually a good sales prospect.

o How you navigate past gatekeepers to speak directly with the owner.

3. A screenshot of your current internet speed test.
