description:
Job Description:

We're a multi-chain DeFi protocol building LP Bonds, a new liquidity primitive that locks liquidity long-term while keeping user positions tradable. We need Business Development partners who can introduce us to crypto launchpads, DEXs, chains, and established crypto projects.



THE OPPORTUNITY:

 Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.



COMPENSATION:

Base Pay: $10/hour, 10 hours/week ($100/week). Paid 50% in Ethereum (ETH) and 50% in $GMI tokens on an 18-month vesting schedule, building you a long-term position in the multi-chain $GMI ecosystem.

Minimum Requirement: 1 qualified appointment per week. A qualified appointment means a scheduled call that actually takes place between me and a decision-maker (founder, BD lead, or marketing head) at a crypto launchpad, DEX, chain, or established project, and meets our qualification criteria. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).



Commission: Commission: 25% of all upgrade fees generated by your partnerships for the first 90 days after the partnership goes live, then 10% through month 12. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.



Bond Bonuses (based on total dollar value of bonds minted through your partnerships):

+$500 when $10,000 is reached

+$1,000 when $20,000 is reached

+$5,000 when $100,000 is reached, and another +$5,000 for every additional $100,000. No ceiling.

Bonuses are cumulative. Hit $100,000 minted and you've collected $6,500 in bonuses total. Every $100,000 after that adds another $5,000.



Note: A successful partnership means a project you introduced signs the LP Bonds integration agreement and goes live on our marketplace. You book the qualified call, I run the deal and close it.



YOU HAVE:

Existing connections in crypto (launchpads, DEXs, chains, established projects)

/
 relationships with project founders or marketing heads

Understanding of DeFi/crypto space

Hunger to earn based on results, not hours



YOU DON'T NEED:

To close deals (I handle that)

Any upfront investment

Previous BD experience (connections matter more)



THE ROLE:

 Your job is booking qualified calls. You reach into your network, find decision-makers at crypto projects, and get them on a scheduled call with me. I close the deals, you collect appointment bonuses, commissions, and bond bonuses as your partnerships go live and grow.

Example: ONE solid launchpad partnership that mints $100,000 in bonds earns you $6,500 in bond bonuses, and with thousands of bondholders paying upgrade fees, your 25% commission pushes your total past $8,000.

Ready to turn your crypto connections into serious income?



Apply with:

List 3-5 crypto projects/launchpads you have connections with

Your
 handle

Brief description of your crypto involvement



We need partners who see the opportunity and want to run with it.

title: Crypto Business Development Manager | Partnerships & Appointment Setting
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn, email, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: CRO Specialist / Growth Designer (A/B Testing)
description:
We are a growing DTC e-commerce group and are hiring one person to own our conversion program: build product pages, landing pages, and offers, A/B test them, read the data, and ship the winners, every week. You will work directly with the founders, our media buyer, and our ad creative team. We have enough traffic to run several real tests every month, so you will see results fast. 



This is not a "make it look pretty" job. We care about revenue per visitor.



What You Will Do:

Build pages and funnels:

- Design product pages, advertorials / pre-landers, listicles, bundle pages, and upsell / cross-sell flows

- Build landing pages that match the ad angles that are scaling 

- Set up post-purchase upsells, the cart drawer, and checkout settings

- Keep a library of proven page templates and sections



Design and test offers:

- Test bundles, tiered pricing, quantity breaks, free-gift and free-shipping thresholds, and discount framing

- Run price and offer tests

- Calculate the margin impact before any offer goes live, no offer ships without a profit-per-order calculation



Run A/B tests:

- Keep a prioritized test backlog (hypothesis, expected impact, effort)

- Launch multiple tests per week, each with a written hypothesis and a clear success metric

- Calculate sample size before launch and run tests to statistical significance

- Keep a test log: what changed, dates, traffic, result, decision, learning

- Roll out winners everywhere they apply; document losers so we never re-test them



Analyze:

- Weekly review Shopify analytics: funnel drop-off by step, device, traffic source, landing page

- Review heatmaps and session recordings to find friction

- Mine customer support tickets, reviews, and surveys for objections and copy angles

- Monthly competitor check (pages and offers)



Report: 

- Weekly report: tests running, tests finished, results, next launches, RPV / CVR / AOV trend

- Monthly report: total lift, learnings, next month's backlog, recommendations for ads and creative

- Tell the media buyer which landers get traffic and at what split; feed winning hooks and objections back to the creative team



Your KPIs:

- Revenue per visitor 

- Profit per visitor / margin per order

- Conversion rate and AOV 

- Tests launched per month and win rate

- Add-to-cart rate and checkout completion rate



Requirements: 

- Experience building Shopify pages for e-commerce brands (DTC, dropshipping, or CRO / e-commerce agency)

- Built advertorials / pre-landers matched to specific ad angles

- You have run real A/B tests and can show results with numbers (CVR, RPV, AOV), including tests that lost

- You have run at least one price or offer test

- Comfortable with GA4, Shopify analytics, and Clarity

- You can explain sample size and statistical significance in simple words

- Good understanding of direct-response basics: hook, proof, objections, urgency

- Strong written English; clear, short reports

- Reliable internet, a good computer, and a quiet workspace

- Shopify Liquid / theme development knowledge



What We Offer:

- Full-time, long-term remote position

- Salary depending on experience, with room for increases based on results

- Real traffic, real budget, and real ownership of the test program

- Direct access to the founder, fast decisions, no bureaucracy

- Room to grow as the team grows



How to Apply:

1) Send your CV

2) 3 to 5 A/B tests you have run, at least one that LOST. For each test, include:

- Context: niche, page type, and rough traffic (sessions/day or orders/day)

- What data gave you the idea (heatmap, drop-off, survey, reviews, tickets)

- Your hypothesis in one sentence

- What you changed (control vs. variant, screenshots or a Loom are welcome as support)

- Tool used, traffic split, how long it ran, and sample size

- Result: CVR / RPV / AOV before and after, and whether it reached significance

- Decision: rolled out, killed, or iterated, and what you learned

You can hide brand names for NDA reasons. Relative numbers (for example "+11% RPV") are required.

3) Links to 2–3 live pages you built

4) A short answer to this question: "Tell us about a test you were sure would win, and it lost. What did you learn?"

5) A screenshot of a test log or weekly report you keep (redacted is fine)

6) If possible, a 3–5 minute Loom video walking us through one of your tests



Applications with no screenshots and no numbers will not be considered.

title: VFX Compositor / Chroma Key & Rotoscoping Artist
description:
# VFX Compositor / Chroma Key & Rotoscoping Artist



**Remote | Project-Based | Philippines**



## About the Project



Organized Movements is producing a cinematic branded video project titled **The Superpower of Business**.



The production features approximately 10 business professionals filmed primarily against green screen. The creative concept uses a cinematic, superhero-inspired visual style to transform the talent from a traditional studio environment into polished, dramatic environments that support the story.



We are looking for an experienced **VFX Compositor / Chroma Key & Rotoscoping Artist** who can take professionally filmed green-screen footage and make each subject look naturally integrated into the final environment.



This is **not simply a background-removal job**. We are looking for someone who understands professional compositing and can make the finished shots feel intentional, cinematic, and believable.



## Responsibilities



You will work with professionally recorded footage and creative direction provided by our production team.



Your responsibilities may include:



* Professional green-screen/chroma key removal

* Advanced keying and edge refinement

* Hair and fine-detail preservation

* Green-spill suppression

* Manual rotoscoping when chroma keying alone is not sufficient

* Masking and object isolation

* Motion tracking

* Camera tracking when required

* Compositing subjects into supplied or created environments

* Matching foreground and background perspective

* Realistic contact shadows and environmental shadows

* Light wrapping and environmental lighting integration

* Color correction and color matching between subjects and backgrounds

* Depth of field and realistic lens treatment

* Motion blur where appropriate

* Atmospheric effects and subtle environmental enhancements

* Cleanup of unwanted objects, green-screen imperfections, stands, edges, or artifacts

* Integration of visual effects that support the cinematic storytelling

* Maintaining realistic skin tones and natural subject appearance

* Creating polished final composites suitable for commercial distribution



Some scenes may require more detailed rotoscoping or compositing than others.



## Visual Standard



The finished piece should feel like a **cinematic commercial**, not like people pasted over digital backgrounds.



We are especially interested in artists who understand how to use:



**lighting + shadows + perspective + depth + color + atmosphere**



to make a composite feel believable.



The effects should enhance the story without becoming cheesy, cartoonish, or overly artificial.



## Required Skills



Applicants should have strong demonstrated experience with:



* Chroma key / green-screen compositing

* Rotoscoping

* Masking

* Motion tracking

* VFX compositing

* Color matching

* Shadow and lighting integration

* 4K video workflows



Experience using one or more of the following is preferred:



* Adobe After Effects

* DaVinci Resolve / Fusion

* Nuke

* Mocha Pro

* Blender

* Cinema 4D

* Similar professional VFX/compositing software



You do **not** have to use a particular application as long as you can deliver professional results.



## What We Are NOT Looking For



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily:



* CapCut editing

* Basic background removal

* Social-media captions

* Templates and transitions

* AI-generated one-click green-screen removal

* Basic Premiere Pro editing without professional compositing experience



We specifically need someone with demonstrated **VFX compositing, chroma keying, masking, and/or rotoscoping experience**.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. A link to your portfolio or demo reel.

2. **2–3 examples that specifically demonstrate green-screen compositing, rotoscoping, masking, or realistic VFX integration.**

3. Tell us exactly what work you performed on each example.

4. List the primary software you use.

5. Tell us your experience working with 4K footage.

6. Tell us your typical turnaround time for VFX/compositing work.

7. Let us know whether you are comfortable receiving and transferring large video files.

8. Briefly describe your process for making a green-screen subject look realistically integrated into a new environment.



Please begin your application with the word **SUPERPOWER** so we know you have read the complete project description.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a **paid test shot** before being selected for the complete project.



We are looking for someone who communicates well, responds reliably to feedback, pays close attention to detail, and takes pride in creating polished visual work.



There is potential for additional project work with our production company for the right artist.

title: Real Estate Seller Closer / Acquisition & Listing Specialist
description:
REAL ESTATE SELLER CLOSER / ACQUISITION & LISTING SPECIALIST



We are seeking an experienced **Real Estate Seller Closer** to work with warm, qualified U.S. property-owner leads and convert conversations into opportunities and deals.



**THIS IS NOT A COLD-CALLING OR APPOINTMENT-SETTING POSITION.**

### FOLLOW UP BOSS EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED.  **You MUST already know how to use Follow Up Boss.**



Our prospecting and lead-generation team makes the initial contact with property owners. You will work primarily with sellers who have already expressed interest, requested information, spoken with our team, or require continued follow-up.



Your job is to own the seller conversation, uncover the seller's real motivation, discuss price and expectations, handle objections, explain available selling options, negotiate when appropriate, and move the seller toward a clear commitment.



### ABOUT OUR SELLER PROGRAMS:

We operate multiple real estate seller programs, including **Seller Options Now (SON)** and **Realty Offers Now (RON)**.



Unlike companies that offer homeowners only one solution, our business is designed to give sellers multiple ways to sell.



Depending upon the property and seller's objectives, potential solutions may include:

* Direct cash/investor purchase

* Competitive offer or accelerated-sale strategy

* Traditional real estate listing

* Competitive online sale / Offer-to-Sold strategy

* Continued nurture and follow-up when the seller is not ready today



The successful candidate must listen to the seller, understand what they're trying to accomplish, and guide the conversation toward the right solution.



### YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

* Call warm and qualified seller leads

* Follow up consistently with previously contacted property owners

* Build rapport quickly with U.S. homeowners

* Determine seller motivation, timing, property condition, price expectations, and decision-making factors

* Ask strong discovery questions instead of simply reading a script

* Handle pricing objections professionally

* Discuss unrealistic seller expectations without losing rapport

* Negotiate with motivated property sellers

* Explain multiple selling options clearly and confidently

* Maintain control and direction of telephone conversations

* Ask for commitments and establish definite next steps

* Recognize when a seller should move toward a direct purchase, listing, competitive-sale solution, or continued nurture

* Maintain persistent follow-up with sellers who are not ready immediately

* Keep complete and accurate CRM notes after every conversation

* Create and manage follow-up tasks

* Maintain correct stages, tags, and pipeline status

* Communicate important opportunities to management

* Help move qualified seller opportunities from initial interest toward signed agreements and completed transactions



You should have hands-on experience using Follow Up Boss for:

* Contacts

* Notes

* Tasks

* Calling

* Text messaging

* Email

* Stages

* Tags

* Smart Lists

* Action Plans

* Follow-up

* Pipeline management



Please do not apply if you have never personally used Follow Up Boss.



### EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Strong candidates will have previous experience with one or more of the following:

* Real estate acquisitions

* Motivated seller leads

* U.S. real estate investing

* Acquisition management

* Wholesale real estate

* Residential real estate sales

* Real estate ISA / inside sales

* Listing conversion

* Seller lead management

* High-ticket telephone sales

* Negotiation and objection handling



Experience speaking directly with U.S. property owners is strongly preferred.



You should be comfortable speaking with sellers in situations involving:

* Inherited properties

* Vacant properties

* Landlords

* Properties needing repairs

* Distressed properties

* Relocation

* Financial pressure

* Foreclosure situations

* Sellers considering a Realtor

* Sellers comparing cash offers

* Sellers with unrealistic price expectations

* Sellers who need repeated follow-up before making a decision



### THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT POSITION IF YOU:

* Mainly schedule appointments

* Only have cold-calling experience

* Depend completely on a script

* Are uncomfortable discussing money

* Are afraid to challenge a seller's price expectations

* Give up after receiving an objection

* Do not follow up consistently

* Need someone to tell you every day who to call

* Fail to maintain detailed CRM records

* Have never worked with motivated property sellers



We want someone who understands the difference between **having a conversation and advancing a deal.**



### COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENTS



Excellent spoken and written English is required.



Because you will speak directly with U.S. homeowners, your telephone communication must be professional, natural, confident, conversational, and easy to understand.



We care much more about your ability to communicate, listen, negotiate, and close than we do about having a perfect résumé.



### WORKING HOURS



You must be available during **U.S. Eastern Time business and early-evening seller contact hours**.



The position is expected to begin at approximately **30 hours per week**, with the opportunity to expand based upon performance and lead volume.



### COMPENSATION

Base compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated ability.



Expected range:

**$800–$2,000 USD per month**



Exceptional candidates may qualify for additional **performance-based bonuses and transaction incentives**.



We are looking for a long-term team member. Strong performance can lead to increased responsibility, compensation, and the opportunity to play a larger role in our seller-conversion operation.



### REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS



You must have:

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer

* Professional headset with microphone

* Quiet and professional calling environment

* Backup internet or power solution preferred

* Ability to participate in video meetings

* Ability to work reliably during agreed U.S. hours



### HOW TO APPLY



**Generic applications will not be considered.**



Your application must include the information requested below.



Start your application with the words:



**“I CLOSE SELLER LEADS”**



This shows you read the entire job posting carefully.



Then answer each of the following questions:



1. Describe your experience speaking directly with motivated U.S. property sellers.



2. What real estate companies or investors have you previously worked with, and what exactly were you responsible for?



3. Were you primarily a cold caller/appointment setter, or were you personally responsible for converting and closing seller opportunities? Explain.



4. Approximately how many seller leads did you personally handle each week?



5. Approximately how many resulted in contracts, listings, appointments, or other committed opportunities?



6. Describe your experience with **Follow Up Boss**. Tell us specifically which Follow Up Boss features you have personally used.



7. A homeowner tells you: “Zillow says my house is worth $250,000, so I'm not taking $190,000.”



Write exactly what you would say next as if you were actually speaking with the seller. Do not explain your sales strategy.



8. A homeowner says: “I'm not in a hurry. I'll just list it with a Realtor if I don't get my price.”



Write exactly how you would continue the conversation.



9. Tell us about one difficult seller objection you successfully overcame. What was the objection, what did you say or do, and what happened?



10. Have you ever worked for a company that could offer sellers multiple solutions, such as cash purchase, traditional listing, novation, auction/competitive sale, seller financing, or another sale strategy? Explain.



11. What hours can you consistently work in U.S. Eastern Time?



12. What monthly base compensation are you seeking?



### REQUIRED VOICE SAMPLE



Include a link to a **60–90 second voice or video introduction**.



Tell us:

* Your name

* Your real estate sales experience

* How long you have worked with U.S. property sellers

* Your Follow Up Boss experience

* Why you believe you can close motivated seller leads



We may not consider applications without the requested voice/video introduction.



We are specifically looking for someone who has already spoken with **motivated property sellers and moved those conversations toward contracts, listings, or another definitive commitment.**



If you are an experienced seller closer looking for a long-term position where your ability to convert opportunities will be recognized and rewarded, we want to hear from you.

title: Real Estate Acquisition & Seller Solutions Closer – Listings, Cash Offers & Online Auctions

We are building a different kind of real estate seller-conversion platform and looking for an experienced **Real Estate Acquisition / Seller Solutions Closer** who can speak confidently with U.S. property owners and help them determine the best way to sell.



This position is for someone who understands that **not every motivated seller should be forced into a wholesale cash offer.**



Depending on the seller's goals, property, equity, condition, timing, and price expectations, we may be able to offer several different solutions.



Our goal is simple:



**Understand what the seller is trying to accomplish and move them toward the best available solution.**



### OUR PLATFORMS



Our seller and competitive-sale programs include:



**Realty Offers Now**  

Our seller-facing real estate marketplace and seller-solutions platform.



**
**  

Our competitive online bidding platform used for online real estate sales and auction-style transactions.



**Seller Options Now**  

Our motivated-seller platform for direct purchase opportunities and alternative seller solutions.



Our business combines traditional real estate, investor acquisitions, seller lead conversion, and competitive online bidding.



### SELLER SOLUTIONS MAY INCLUDE



Depending upon the seller and property:



- Direct cash / investor purchase

- Traditional real estate listing

- Competitive online bidding

- Real estate auction

- Offer-to-Sold competitive-sale strategy

- Accelerated sale

- Other structured seller solutions

- Continued follow-up and nurture when the seller is not ready today



We are looking for someone who can recognize the difference between these opportunities and confidently explain the appropriate solution to the seller.



### THIS IS A CLOSING POSITION



This is NOT primarily an appointment-setting position.



Our lead-generation team identifies and contacts property owners.



You will work primarily with:



- Interested sellers

- Warm seller leads

- Previously contacted property owners

- Sellers requesting offers

- Aged leads requiring re-engagement

- Property owners considering a Realtor

- Sellers whose price does not fit a traditional investor acquisition

- Sellers who may benefit from an accelerated or competitive-sale strategy

- Real estate agents who may have properties appropriate for our online bidding platform



Your responsibility is to **advance the opportunity.**

- Discuss property condition

- Maintain detailed CRM records

- Coordinate qualified opportunities with management and licensed real estate professionals

- Help move seller opportunities toward signed agreements and completed transactions



### THE PERSON WE WANT

- Acquisition Manager

- Real Estate Sales Closer

- Disposition Manager

- Wholesale Acquisition Manager

- Inside Sales Agent

### DIRECT REAL ESTATE CLOSING EXPERIENCE IS HIGHLY VALUED



We want to hear from candidates who have personally:



- Presented offers to homeowners

- Discussed purchase prices

- Negotiated with sellers

- Handled price objections

- Followed sellers over multiple conversations

- Obtained purchase agreements

- Helped obtain listing agreements

- Worked transactions from lead through contract

- Coordinated closings

- Worked acquisitions and/or dispositions



If your only real estate experience is reading a cold-calling script and scheduling appointments, this is probably not the right position.



### MULTIPLE-SOLUTION SELLING



One of the most important parts of this role is recognizing that not every seller belongs in the same box.



For example:



A seller who needs immediate certainty and has a property requiring major repairs may be appropriate for a direct purchase.



A seller who wants closer to full market value may be better suited for a traditional listing.



A property where competitive buyer demand may produce a better result could be appropriate for a competitive online sale through RealtyBidNow.



A seller who wants market exposure but also wants a defined selling timeline may be appropriate for our Offer-to-Sold strategy.



Your job is to ask enough questions to determine the appropriate direction.



### REALTOR / AGENT OPPORTUNITIES



This position may also involve conversations with real estate agents.



RealtyBidNow can be used as an additional selling tool for agents who have clients or properties that may benefit from a competitive online sale or accelerated-sale strategy.



We cooperate with real estate professionals rather than attempting to remove them from the transaction.



Depending upon the opportunity and written agreement:



- The referring/listing agent may remain involved with their seller

- The agent remains informed and included

- Property marketing is coordinated collaboratively

- Photography and property presentation remain important

- Agent participation and referrals may be compensated according to the specific written agreement

- Our online bidding platform can become an additional tool for the agent and their client



You must be comfortable speaking professionally with both homeowners and real estate professionals.



### CRM EXPERIENCE



Experience with real estate CRM systems is important.



**Follow Up Boss experience is strongly preferred, but it is NOT mandatory for an otherwise exceptional acquisition closer.**



Experience with any of the following is valuable:

- Podio

- GoHighLevel

- InvestorFuse

- REISimpli

- REI BlackBook

- REI Reply

- Salesforce

- HubSpot

- Pipedrive

- LionDesk



You must be comfortable managing:

- Tasks

- Pipelines

- Calls

- Text messages

- Email communication

- Long-term nurture

- Detailed seller histories

- Inherited / estate property owners

- Tired landlords

- Absentee owners

- Vacant-property owners

- Properties needing significant repairs

- Pre-foreclosure owners

- Owners experiencing financial pressure

- Sellers relocating

- Investors

- Owners of rental property

- Commercial property owners

- Landowners

- Sellers with unrealistic price expectations

- Sellers considering traditional Realtors

- Sellers who already received investor offers

- Sellers who need weeks or months of follow-up before d



### COMMUNICATION STYLE



We do NOT want a robotic script reader.



You should be:



- Confident

- Professional

- Conversational

- Curious

- Persistent

- Comfortable discussing money

- Comfortable asking difficult questions

- Able to listen

- Able to challenge assumptions respectfully

- Able to control a sales conversation without being aggressive



Excellent spoken English is required.



### COMPENSATION



Expected base compensation:



**$1,000–$2,500 USD per month depending on experience**



We are especially interested in creating a compensation structure that rewards results.



Qualified candidates may receive:



- Base compensation

- Performance bonuses

- Signed-agreement bonuses

- Transaction bonuses

- Closing incentives

- Other performance-based compensation



The exact structure will depend upon the candidate's experience and role.



Exceptional performance may lead to increased responsibility in seller conversion, acquisition management, sales operations, or team leadership.



### WORKING HOURS



Approximately **30–40 hours per week**.



You must have meaningful overlap with **U.S. Eastern Time**, including normal daytime seller-contact hours.



This is intended to become a long-term position.



### REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS

- Reliable computer

- High-speed internet

- Quiet professional workspace

- Quality microphone/headset

- Ability to participate in video meetings

- Reliable availability during agreed U.S. hours

- Backup internet or power solution strongly preferred



### HOW TO APPLY

Applications that do not include this phrase may not be reviewed.



Then answer the following questions.

title: Director of Business Operations and Systems
description:
DIRECTOR OF BUSINESS OPERATIONS AND SYSTEMS

WORK SETUP: Fully remote and full time

EXPERIENCE: 5 years above

REPORTS TO: Owner

COMPENSATION: $500/week



Position Summary



High Meadows Resorts is developing a luxury destination property in Ellicottville, New York, with 17 rental villas, a full-service restaurant, and an event center serving banquet, corporate gatherings, wellness retreats, celebrations, and group stays.



We are seeking a senior hospitality operator to build the commercial and operating foundation before opening and strengthen it as the business grows. This person will own business development, financial models, operating systems, software integration, workforce planning, and team adherence to agreed processes. The role works directly with the owner and must be comfortable testing assumptions, identifying risk, and recommending better options with clear financial and operational reasoning.



Key Responsibilities



Business Development and Commercial Planning

•Build and maintain pro formas for the restaurant, villas, event center, and related revenue opportunities. Models should cover demand, pricing, occupancy, average daily rate, food and labor costs, fixed costs, cash flow, and break-even scenarios.

•Develop budgets, forecasts, pricing recommendations, and management dashboards with clear assumptions and measurable targets.

•Create partnership, referral, group sales, and event pipelines with defined stages, owners, follow-up standards, conversion measures, and booked revenue reporting.



Operating Systems and Guest Journey

•Map and improve the full guest journey from inquiry and booking through pre-arrival, check-in, stay, issue recovery, check-out, and post-stay follow-up.

•Create SOPs, checklists, handoffs, approval limits, quality controls, and escalation paths for reservations, housekeeping, maintenance, dining, events, and guest services.

•Establish system governance through assigned owners, version control, training records, compliance reviews, exception reporting, and regular improvement cycles.



Technology and Software Integration

•Define requirements and lead vendor evaluation for the website, booking engine, property management system, channel manager, CRM, point-of-sale, payments, accounting, guest messaging, housekeeping, workforce scheduling, and analytics tools.

•Design the integration map for data flow, permissions, ownership, reporting, handoffs, and failure contingencies.

•Coordinate configuration, testing, training, staff acceptance, and launch readiness with internal owners and external vendors.

title: Insight-Led Content Researcher & Scriptwriter - Psychology
description:
**Part-Time | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity**



We are looking for someone who is unusually good at finding **interesting ideas hidden inside stories**.



This is not a traditional copywriting role.



It is not a social-media VA role.



And we are not looking for someone who simply takes a topic and asks ChatGPT to write a script about it.



Your job is to find stories, contradictions, behaviours and business decisions that make someone think:



**“I've never thought about it like that before.”**



The subject could come from almost anywhere:



* Psychology and human behaviour

* Relationships

* Business and entrepreneurship

* Famous companies and brands

* Celebrity and internet culture

* Sport

* Status and ambition

* Money

* History

* Technology

* Crime

* Advertising

* Strange cultural trends

* Unexpected success or failure stories



The industry matters less than whether there is a **strong idea underneath the story**.



## The Type of Content We Create



For example:



Kim Kardashian's story can become a script about how scandal changed from something that destroyed fame into something that can manufacture it.



Ferrari having hundreds of millions of fans but relatively few customers can become a script about how people who never buy your product can still increase its value.



Home Depot filling its early stores with empty paint cans can become a script about how perception influences whether customers trust a new business.



A chaotic relationship can become a script about how the person creating your anxiety can also become the person you depend on for relief.



Someone surviving extreme violence but being terrified to apologise to their father can become a script about how people often choose difficult things that preserve control while avoiding the difficult thing that removes it.



The interesting part is rarely just **what happened**.



The job is finding:



**Why is this interesting?**



**What does this reveal?**



**What is the hidden mechanism?**



**Why would somebody who knows nothing about the original story care?**



## What We Do NOT Want



We are not looking for generic content like:



“5 signs of a toxic relationship.”



“3 ways to grow your business.”



“Why Rolex is successful.”



“Ferrari has a strong brand.”



“Know your worth.”



“Work hard and never give up.”



These are observations anyone could make.



We want the layer underneath the obvious observation.



For example:



Weak:



**“Rolex is successful because people like luxury watches.”**



Better:



**“Scarcity has almost nothing to do with making a small number of products. Rolex can make around a million watches and still create scarcity because demand outruns supply.”**



Weak:



**“Ferrari has a powerful brand.”**



Better:



**“Ferrari's biggest fans may never become customers — but those non-customers help create the cultural status that makes the product valuable to the people who do buy.”**



That difference is the job.



## Your Role



You will own much of the research and early script-development process.



This includes:



* Finding fascinating podcasts, interviews, documentaries, articles, Reddit discussions, company stories and historical examples

* Reviewing long transcripts and source material

* Identifying unusual facts, contradictions and stories

* Finding the deeper idea underneath the obvious story

* Researching additional supporting evidence where necessary

* Developing strong hooks

* Turning the strongest ideas into short-form scripts

* Checking our existing script library to avoid repeating ideas we have already covered

* Adding completed scripts to Notion for final review



You can use **ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools heavily**.



We actively expect you to.



But AI is not the skill we're hiring for.



The valuable skill is knowing when the AI has produced something obvious, boring or fake-deep — and being able to push past it.



## The Most Important Skill: Taste



We care heavily about your ability to distinguish between:



**An interesting topic**



and



**An interesting idea.**



“Ferrari” is a topic.



“Millions of people who will never own a Ferrari help make Ferrari more valuable to the people who can” is an idea.



“Relationships” is a topic.



“The person causing your anxiety can become the person you depend on for relief” is an idea.



“Success” is a topic.



“Success can be more psychologically destabilising than failure because failure allows you to keep believing happiness is waiting at the next milestone” is an idea.



We want someone who naturally looks for the second version.



## What We're Looking For



Strong candidates may come from backgrounds such as:



* Psychology

* Behavioural science

* Journalism

* Sociology

* Philosophy

* Copywriting

* Documentary research

* Business research

* Content strategy



A degree is not required.



What matters more is:



* Exceptional curiosity

* Strong pattern recognition

* Good judgment about what people will actually find fascinating

* Ability to read or watch something long and find the 2% worth turning into content

* Strong written English

* Ability to simplify complex ideas without making them simplistic

* Ability to find strong evidence and examples

* Comfort using AI tools

* Willingness to reject mediocre ideas rather than forcing every source into a script

* Strong organisation and reliability



## Important



We don't want academic writing.



We don't want corporate LinkedIn writing.



And we don't want scripts that sound as if somebody asked AI:



**“Give me a motivational lesson from this story.”**



For example, instead of:



> “This behaviour represents an anxious-avoidant attachment dynamic caused by intermittent reinforcement.”



We prefer:



> “The person making you anxious can become the same person you depend on for relief.”



Instead of:



> “Strong brands benefit from high levels of social proof.”



We prefer:



> “Ferrari has hundreds of millions of fans who will never buy the car — but those people are part of what makes owning one mean something.”



The research can be sophisticated.



The final idea should feel obvious **only after someone explains it**.



## Hours



This will begin as a small **part-time role**.



Approximately 10** hours per week initially**.



Hours can increase substantially if the quality of the work is strong.



We are looking for someone who can potentially grow into a long-term role.



## Paid Trial



Shortlisted applicants will complete a **paid trial**.



We will give you:



* Examples of our strongest existing scripts

* Source material such as a transcript, interview or company story

* Access to examples showing the standard we're looking for



You will be asked to:



1. Research the source.

2. Identify several possible angles.

3. Choose what you believe is the strongest one.

4. Explain briefly why.

5. Write one finished short-form script.



We are primarily testing:



* **Taste**

* Research ability

* Pattern recognition

* Ability to find the non-obvious angle

* Hook selection

* Depth of insight

* Writing ability



We are **not** testing whether you can follow a huge prompt perfectly.



We want to see how you think.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your research, writing or relevant educational background.



2. What subjects you naturally spend time researching.



3. One example of a story, company, person or behaviour you think could make a fascinating short-form script — and briefly explain the hidden idea you would explore.



4. Begin your application with the word **“INSIGHT”** so we know you read the full post.



If you naturally consume a story and find yourself thinking:



**“Everyone is focusing on what happened. The interesting part is why it worked that way.”**



you may be a very good fit for this role.

What You'll Do

Research interesting economics, finance, and business topics.

Find strong angles and stories for videos.

Research competitors and what's currently performing.

Find reliable sources and data.

Help develop video ideas, hooks, and titles.

Requirements



You must have previous YouTube experience.



When applying, send:



A YouTube channel you have worked on.

What your role was.

The results you helped achieve.

We’re looking for someone who understands YouTube, not just research.

title: COMMUNITY & CONTENT MANAGER (CANVA + Ai + GHL)
description:
Compensation: $500/month

Schedule: Thursday through Monday, 12:00 PM–8:00 PM Pacific Time

Start Date: Immediately

Hours: 40 hrs/week

Days: 5 days/week

Type: Remote, Non-Exclusive Contractor

Location: Remote



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a reliable, responsive, and highly organized Community & Content Manager with strong Canva skills to manage the day-to-day activity, content, events, and organization of up to five online communities.



This is first and foremost a community management role. You will be responsible for keeping your assigned communities active, organized, visually polished, current, and running smoothly.



Strong Canva skills are a must. You must also be comfortable using Ai effectively and working within GoHighLevel (GHL).



We are having an interview round TODAY the day this is posted, September 19 in California:

Community & Canva Specialist interviews 9:30 – 10:00am Pacifc





If you have community management and Canva skills, come join!



WHAT YOU'LL DO



You may be responsible for up to five communities at the same time.



Your responsibilities will include:



• Manage day-to-day community activity

• Create, schedule, and publish regular community content

• Maintain content and posting calendars

• Create and maintain community event calendar entries, including images, descriptions, dates, times, and links

• Create Canva graphics for posts, announcements, events, webinars, promotions, and other community activities

• Coordinate community events, webinars, and live sessions

• Post event announcements, reminders, and follow-up content

• Keep pinned posts, resources, links, and community information current

• Monitor community activity and respond to routine questions when appropriate

• Escalate questions or issues requiring specialized attention

• Organize graphics, documents, videos, recordings, templates, links, and other community assets

• Create and maintain logical folder structures and naming conventions

• Keep Canva templates and reusable creative assets organized

• Create, maintain, and follow SOPs for recurring community activities

• Create checklists and repeatable workflows where appropriate

• Make basic updates within GoHighLevel

• Use Ai tools for content, research, images, problem-solving, and productivity

• Follow up on open tasks and make sure things do not fall through the cracks

• Provide a clear handoff when something remains open at the end of your shift



CANVA SKILLS ARE REQUIRED



Canva is a significant part of this position.



You should be able to:



• Create polished community and social graphics

• Create event, webinar, announcement, and promotional graphics

• Work efficiently from existing Canva templates and brand guidelines

• Create new layouts when needed

• Resize and adapt creative for different platforms and formats

• Work effectively with photos, logos, backgrounds, typography, and other visual elements

• Maintain the distinct visual identity of multiple communities

• Organize Canva templates and reusable assets

• Recognize when a design looks cluttered, unbalanced, off-brand, low-quality, or obviously Ai-generated



You do not need to be a professional graphic designer, but you do need to be genuinely good at Canva and have strong visual judgment.



USING Ai WELL



We expect you to be comfortable using modern Ai tools as part of your everyday work.



You should know how to use Ai for:



• Drafting and improving community content

• Repurposing existing content

• Research and brainstorming

• Summarizing source material

• Image generation and editing

• Learning unfamiliar tools

• Problem-solving

• Improving the speed and quality of your work



However, copying and pasting generic Ai-generated content is not acceptable.



Final content should:



• Sound natural and human

• Be clear and conversational

• Be specific rather than abstract

• Match the audience and voice of the individual community

• Avoid unnecessary hype and filler

• Avoid repetitive or formulaic Ai phrasing

• Avoid unnecessary em dashes

• Not read like generic Ai-generated content



We sometimes refer to generic, low-quality Ai-generated writing as "Ai slop." We don't want it.



Ai should make you a better and faster Community Manager. It should not replace your judgment, writing ability, creativity, or understanding of the audience.



CONTENT & EVENT MANAGEMENT



You will be responsible for keeping content and events organized across your assigned communities.



For a typical event, you should be capable of owning the complete workflow:



Event Confirmed → Calendar Entry Created → Graphic Created → Announcement Posted → Reminders Scheduled → Event Supported → Follow-Up Posted



This may include:



• Confirming dates and times

• Creating calendar entries

• Writing event descriptions

• Adding registration, meeting, or webinar links

• Creating Canva graphics

• Publishing announcements

• Scheduling reminders

• Coordinating with hosts and team members

• Making sure required materials are ready

• Supporting event execution

• Publishing recordings, resources, or follow-up content



You should recognize the steps required to successfully execute an event rather than waiting for someone to assign every individual task.



ORGANIZATION & SOP OWNERSHIP



Organization is a major part of this role.



You are not simply expected to locate files, graphics, templates, and other assets. You are expected to create and maintain the organizational structure that makes those things easy for everyone to find and use.



You will:



• Organize graphics, documents, videos, recordings, links, templates, and other digital assets

• Create and maintain logical folder structures

• Establish and follow clear naming conventions

• Keep Canva templates and brand assets organized

• Maintain content and event calendars

• Maintain commonly used links, resources, and reference materials

• Create SOPs for recurring responsibilities

• Follow existing SOPs consistently

• Update SOPs as processes change

• Create checklists for repeatable activities

• Identify recurring activities that should become documented processes

• Keep documentation current enough that another team member could step in and understand what to do



Your communities and their supporting assets should stay organized because you manage them, not because someone else periodically has to clean them up.



GOHIGHLEVEL



You should have working familiarity with GoHighLevel or be capable of becoming productive in it quickly.



Depending on the community, you may be asked to:



• Work within GHL Communities

• Update calendars and events

• Make basic changes to pages or funnels

• Update text, images, links, buttons, or forms

• Work with contacts and other basic GHL functionality

• Follow established GHL workflows and SOPs



We are not hiring a GHL developer. We are looking for a Community Manager who is comfortable operating inside GHL.



RESPONSIVENESS & OWNERSHIP



During your assigned coverage hours, you must be reachable and responsive.



When a request comes in:



Request Received → Acknowledge → Investigate → Handle → Verify → Confirm → Escalate/Handoff if Needed



If you do not immediately know how to accomplish something, investigate it. Use Ai. Review the SOP. Try to solve it.



If something requires specialized expertise or authority you do not have, escalate rather than guess.



During quieter periods, proactively review:



• Your assigned communities

• Upcoming content and posts

• Content calendars

• Upcoming events

• Graphics that need to be prepared

• Calendar accuracy

• Outdated information

• Unanswered questions

• Open tasks and follow-ups

• Asset and folder organization

• SOPs and documentation that need to be created or updated



The role is non-exclusive. You may work with other clients or projects as long as they do not interfere with your responsibilities or responsiveness during assigned coverage hours.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for someone who has:



• Community management experience

• Strong Canva skills

• Strong practical Ai skills

• Working familiarity with GoHighLevel or the ability to learn it quickly

• Strong writing and editing ability

• The ability to recognize and remove poor-quality Ai writing

• Experience managing content calendars

• Experience coordinating online events or webinars

• Strong organizational skills

• Experience organizing digital assets

• Experience creating, maintaining, and following SOPs

• Strong attention to detail

• Good visual judgment

• Strong written communication

• Reliability and responsiveness

• Ability to work independently

• Ability to manage multiple communities without mixing up their brands, audiences, assets, or schedules

• Good judgment about when to solve something independently and when to escalate



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer all questions clearly in your application:



1. What online communities have you managed, and what were your responsibilities?

2. How many communities or brands have you managed simultaneously?

3. Describe your Canva experience and provide examples of graphics you personally created.

4. Which Ai tools do you regularly use, and how do you use them?

5. How do you prevent Ai-assisted content from sounding generic or obviously Ai-generated?

6. What experience do you have with GoHighLevel?

7. What experience do you have managing content and event calendars?

8. What experience do you have coordinating webinars or online events?

9. How have you organized digital assets, templates, content, or files for a team?

10. Have you created or maintained SOPs? Please provide an example.

11. Are you willing to record short-form videos about various topics, products, and services?

12. Once you have demonstrated that you are effective with short-form video, are you willing to run approximately 45-minute webinars that we have prepared and trained you to deliver?

13. Are you flexible with your schedule and available for a 5-day coverage schedule, including weekends if needed?

14. How soon can you start?



7-DAY EVALUATION PERIOD



All selected candidates will begin with a 7-day evaluation period.



During this period, we will evaluate:



• Community management ability

• Canva capability and visual judgment

• Content quality

• Ability to use Ai without producing generic Ai content

• GHL capability

• Ability to manage multiple communities

• Content and event calendar management

• Event coordination

• Organization

• SOP creation and adherence

• Reliability and responsiveness

• Accuracy and attention to detail

• Proactivity and follow-through

• Communication

• Independent problem-solving

• Judgment about when to handle something and when to escalate



Candidates who successfully demonstrate these capabilities may be offered the opportunity to continue with the team long-term.



THE RIGHT PERSON FOR THIS ROLE



You are a Community Manager first, but you bring a broader skill set than a traditional Community Manager.



You can manage the community, write the post, create the Canva graphic, add the event to the calendar, organize the assets, coordinate the webinar, use Ai intelligently, make a basic GHL update, document the process, and make sure the details don't get missed.



If you are a strong Community Manager who is genuinely good at Canva, comfortable with Ai and GHL, highly organized, responsive, and able to manage multiple communities, we'd like to hear from you.

title: AI Video Editor
description:
We are a fast-growing eCommerce brand that produces high-volume Meta ads and is seeking an exceptionally skilled Paid Social Creative Editor who can produce AI-enhanced video ads and static creatives at scale. This role is for someone who understands direct-response marketing, fast-paced iteration, and AI generation workflows, not basic aesthetic editing. What you will do: 

Create high-volume paid social videos (UGC-style, product demos, problem–solution, voiceover visuals, testimonial edits). 

Generate AI-powered visuals using tools like: 

Google VEO 3 

Higgsfield 

Google Gemini 

AI UGC avatar tools 

AI image generators 

Build static ads using a mix of AI visuals + our existing asset library. 

Receive a creative brief (concept, angle, script) and independently produce: 

3–10 video variations 

5–20 static image variations 

Rapid iterations based on feedback and performance data 

Add engaging on-screen text, captions, VFX, and sound design. 

Incorporate our pre-existing footage + newly generated AI elements. 

Help conceptualize ideas that improve CTR, hook rate, thumbstop ratio, and ROAS. 

Deliver creatives in a Meta-native format (short form, mobile-first, bold text, fast pacing). 



Required Skills + Experience (please do not apply if you don't meet the criteria):



Direct-Response Creative Editing 

Knowledge of high-performing Meta ads formats 

Strong understanding of: Hooks, Pacing, Retention strategy, CTA placement AI Video & Image Generation (Advanced) 

Strong prompting abilities 

Ability to generate:, AI actors/UGC avatars, AI B-roll, AI product shots *

Workflow experience (storyboarding, prompt crafting, refining, upscaling) 

Technical Editing Software Skills 

Adobe Premiere Pro 

CapCut Desktop 

DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut Pro 

Photoshop, Canva, or Figma for static ads 

Ability to sync voiceovers and maintain pacing 

Paid Social Creative Knowledge 

Understanding of creative testing 

Ability to interpret creative performance metrics like: Hook rate, Thumbstop percentage, CTR, Watch-time dropoff 

Work Speed 

MUST be able to produce high-volume output daily 

Must be able to turn around creative requests within 24–48 hours 

English Proficiency 

Must be able to communicate verbally and over text proficiently in English



(SAY PROS)



### Additional Requirements



* **High-Level Editing Skills**



  * Strong professional editing skills beyond basic cuts and captions.

  * Excellent pacing, retention editing, sound design, motion graphics, VFX, transitions, and visual storytelling.



* **AI UGC**



  * Ability to generate realistic AI UGC, including AI actors, customer-style testimonials, expert-style videos, lifestyle scenes, and product-use footage.



* **AI Animation**



  * Experience creating AI-generated animations such as:



    * Medical/scientific animation

    * Motion graphics

    * 2D/3D-style animation

    * Cartoon/stylized animation

    * Mechanism/explainer visuals



* **AI-Generated B-Roll**



  * Ability to read a script and generate high-quality B-roll that directly matches each section of the script.

  * Must understand what visual should appear on screen to support the voiceover instead of using random filler footage.



* **Advanced Prompting**



  * Strong prompting skills for AI image and video generation.

  * Must understand start-frame/reference-image workflows, especially for Higgsfield.

  * Able to prompt for camera movement, character consistency, actions, environment, lighting, realism, product interaction, and scene continuity.

title: Resume Writer

title: Facebook Page Manager for Daily Video Uploads (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
I run a network of faceless YouTube channels and
 pages in six languages. History, mysteries, nostalgia, documentary content. The YouTube side is running. The
 side has grown past what I can publish myself, so I'm hiring one person to take it over completely.



This is not a content creation job and it is not an editing job. The videos already exist. Your job is to move them to
, every day, correctly, without me having to check.



What your day looks like



It looks the same every day, and that is the point.



Each morning you get the day's list. You download the videos from my YouTube channels and publish them to the right
 pages, each with the right caption and the link in the pinned comment. Most of them go up exactly as they are. Some need a quick pass in CapCut first: crop, trim the intro, drop in a text overlay from a template I give you. A few minutes each, nothing complicated.



Around 30 videos a day across the pages. You'll start lower for the first two weeks while you learn the system, then we go up. Four of those videos also go to YouTube with a title, description and thumbnail that I hand you.



You'll use Claude (AI) for parts of the captions. I'll give you the exact prompts. If you've never touched it, that's fine, it takes a day.



Most of your day is downloading, uploading and publishing. It isn't difficult work. It's exact work. Everything is documented and I record a screen video for every step before you have to do it alone. You will never be told to just figure it out.



Anything that publishes on Saturday or Sunday is finished and scheduled by Friday evening. You don't work weekends. You plan ahead so the weekend runs without you.



What you need



Reliable internet, 20 Mbps or better, with a backup option. You'll be pulling down and pushing up video files all day long. If your connection drops, the day stops. This is the single most important requirement.

A computer that handles video files and CapCut without freezing.

Basic CapCut or similar (crop, trim, text). Light work, not motion graphics.

You know
 and YouTube as a user. You do not need to have managed them professionally.

Good written English. You'll read SOPs and write captions.

The ability to repeat the same process precisely 30 times a day without taking shortcuts.



Nice to have, not required



Experience with Meta Business Suite or any scheduling tool

Any experience with ChatGPT or Claude

Basic Canva or thumbnail work

Experience running a
 page of any size



Who you are



Disciplined and reliable above everything else. This job lives or dies on whether things get posted when they're supposed to. Ambitious, because this role is going to grow and I want someone who wants that. A fast learner, because you'll be learning my whole system from scratch.



One thing matters more than experience: if you don't understand something, I need you to tell me. When you message me, start with the word pineapple and the city you live in, so I know you read this far. I would rather answer ten questions a day than fix one silent mistake. Asking is never a problem here. Guessing is.



The conditions



Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM Philippine time, with a one hour break. That's 8 working hours a day, 40 a week.



I'm online from around 3:00 PM your time, so the last four hours of your day overlap with my morning in Europe. That's when we talk. We use WhatsApp, not
.



$600 per month, paid twice a month through Wise (PayPal if you prefer), on the 15th and the last day of the month. No delays, ever.



On top of the fix: 1% of the monthly profit from the
 operation, paid every month. [DOPLŇ: right now that works out to roughly $X a month.] It grows as the pages grow, and you're the person growing them.



13th month pay in December, a full extra salary. Philippine public holidays are your days off.



This is long-term. I am not looking for someone for three months.



Where this goes



I'm one person, not an agency. You talk to me directly, there is nobody in between.



As the pages grow I'll need a second and a third person doing this. Whoever takes this role is first in line to become the one who hires them, trains them and runs them, on a higher fix. That isn't a vague promise about two years from now, it's simply how this team has to grow.



How to apply



Message me and answer these three things, numbered, in this order:



It's 4:00 PM. You've published 18 of today's 30 videos and you already know you won't finish all 30 today. What do you do, and when do you tell me?

A screenshot of a speed test (speedtest.net) plus your computer's processor and RAM.

Two or three sentences on what you're doing now and why this job interests you.



What happens next



I read every application myself. Everyone I'm seriously considering hears back within 3 days. Then a 20 minute WhatsApp call. Then one paid test day: 8 hours of real work, $30, so you see what the job actually feels like and I see how you handle it. If it fits, we start the week after.

title: Commercial Roofing Estimator + Lead Generation VA
description:
About Us

Blitz Roofing and Construction is a growing commercial and residential roofing contractor based in Orlando, Florida. About 70% of our work is commercial. We're looking for a long-term team member who can produce accurate commercial roofing estimates and keep our bid pipeline full.



What You'll Do



Estimating (primary role)



 • Perform roof takeoffs from plans, drawings, and aerial reports

 • Build estimates for commercial systems: TPO, PVC, modified bitumen, built-up, metal, and roof coatings

 • Calculate materials, labor, and accessories (insulation, flashing, drains, edge metal, etc.)

 • Prepare clean, professional proposals for our review

 • Track bid due dates and submit bids on time



Lead Generation (when not estimating)



 • Search ConstructConnect, BuildingConnected, PlanHub, Dodge, and similar platforms for commercial projects in Florida

 • Identify general contractors, property managers, and owners bidding roofing work

 • Download plans and specs, and qualify projects that fit our scope

 • Keep a lead and bid tracker organized and up to date

 • Draft outreach
s to GCs and prospects



Requirements



 • 2+ years of commercial roofing estimating experience for U.S. contractors (required)

 • Skilled in takeoff software such as STACK, or similar

 • Can read construction plans, roof plans, and specs

 • Familiarity with ConstructConnect or other bid-lead platforms is a big plus

 • Strong written English and attention to detail

 • Reliable internet, a dedicated workspace, and a backup power source



Nice to Have



 • Experience with EagleView or aerial measurement reports

 • Florida or hurricane-zone roofing knowledge (wind uplift, FL product approvals)

 • CRM experience with AccuLynx but not required



How to Apply

Send your resume and a short message covering:



 1. Your commercial roofing estimating experience (roof systems and project sizes)

 2. Which takeoff software and lead platforms you've used

 3. A sample estimate or takeoff you've done (with sensitive info removed)



Start your application with the words "TPO Estimator" so we know you read the full post. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

title: On-Camera Host (Remote, Part-Time to Start)
description:

title: Cross-Channel Marketing, SEO & AI Automation Manager
description:
About the Role



We are an international digital marketing and technology agency working with clients across different countries and industries.



We are looking for a proactive Cross-Channel Marketing, SEO & AI Automation Manager to join our team on a full-time, long-term basis.



This is a hands-on role combining SEO, AEO/GEO, content, social media, lead generation, video, analytics and AI automation.



A key part of the role is improving client visibility across traditional search and increasingly AI-powered search environments, while also supporting wider cross-channel marketing activities.



We are looking for someone who understands the business objective, takes ownership and turns opportunities into practical actions.



Key Responsibilities



• Develop and improve SEO, Local SEO, AEO/GEO and AI Search strategies.

• Conduct keyword, competitor, search intent and content opportunity research.

• Optimise website content, landing pages, metadata, internal linking and on-page SEO.

• Identify opportunities to improve visibility across Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and other search environments.

• Plan and coordinate cross-channel marketing activities across websites, LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube and other relevant platforms.

• Create and improve website copy, articles, captions, hooks, headlines and marketing content.

• Support lead generation, landing pages, campaigns and conversion opportunities.

• Create or coordinate social media content, graphics, carousels and other assets.

• Edit short-form and longer-form video where required.

• Monitor performance using GA4, Google Search Console and platform analytics.

• Turn performance data into clear recommendations and actions.

• Use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI tools for research, content, analysis and productivity.

• Build or support practical automations using n8n, Make, Zapier or similar tools.

• Automate areas such as research, content repurposing, reporting, lead collection and repetitive marketing tasks.

• Coordinate with developers, designers and other team members.
